say:0:1422619001:0.text: Things are more serious than I imagined. We have to find Evie and the others quickly.

say:4:1422620002:0.text: I see... I'll also share what I've learned.

say:6:1422620004:0.text: While both have their merits, neither is fully equipped to manage the village's unique challenges. Luckily, administrative management is my area of expertise.

say:8:1422620006:0.source_cn: 如果她们失去价值，我就会尽量减少损失。如果她们有帮助的...

choice_prompt:9:1422620006.text: My duty here is to assist. If their usefulness to the Empire wanes, I'll act to mitigate the fallout. But so long as they prove valuable, they'll have my full support and help.

say:12:1422620009:0.text: Well, first things first. I'll need to officially approve and endorse these mineral findings, then double-check that all our Imperial buyers and distribution routes are secured. Can't have any gaps in the supply chain.
say:12:1422620009:0.source_cn: 目前来看，我这里要做的就是对于新原料的背书和重新确保帝...

choice:2:0:1.text: Here's what the locals had to say...
choice:2:0:1.male: Here's what the locals had to say...
choice:2:0:1.female: Here's what the locals had to say...

say:14:1422620010:0.text: Yes, the current attacks definitely need to be dealt with.
say:14:1422620010:0.source_cn: 如今的遇袭事件，显然是必须要处理的。

say:15:1422620011:0.text: After all, the villagers are subjects of the Empire. Matters concerning the safety of our citizens cannot be ignored.
say:15:1422620011:0.source_cn: 毕竟他们是耀光帝国的子民，这种事关居民切身安全的事务，...

say:16:1422620012:0.text: The problem lies in the fact that these monsters are from Sal'thorin.
say:16:1422620012:0.source_cn: 问题就在于，这些袭击的怪物来自萨洛克兰。

say:17:1422620013:0.source_cn: 我只受命来处理深岩村的事务，而萨洛克兰作为新的国度，也...

say:18:1422620014:0.text: I'm not in a position to interfere. Let alone make any promises as a representative.
say:18:1422620014:0.source_cn: 我没有合适立场去干涉，更无法作为代表进行什么许诺。

say:19:1422620015:0.text: Given my employer's standing, even well-intentioned contact might be misconstrued as exceeding one's authority.
say:19:1422620015:0.source_cn: 那位大人的立场就更不可能公然做出这等越权之举了。

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: （讲述孽化者和萨洛克兰的背后隐情）

say:20:1422620016:0.text: I'd like to ask you all to go to Sal'thorin to investigate the reason for the escalating attacks by the corrupted Essail.
say:20:1422620016:0.source_cn: 所以，我想拜托诸位，前往萨洛克兰去调查一下孽化者袭击增...

say:21:1422620017:0.text: Are they doing it intentionally or just unable to stop them?
say:21:1422620017:0.source_cn: 看看他们究竟是有意放纵，还是无力阻拦。

say:22:1422620018:0.text: Every piece of intelligence we gather today becomes leverage tomorrow. The Empire will decide Sal'thorin's fate based on facts, not rumors... and my employer intends to help shape that decision.

say:24:1422620019:0.male: It's up to you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:24:1422620019:0.female: It's up to you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

choice:23:0:1.text: Understood, I'll go take a look.
choice:23:0:1.male: Understood, I'll go take a look.
choice:23:0:1.female: Understood, I'll go take a look.

choice:2:2:3.text: So, what do we do now?
choice:2:2:3.male: So, what do we do now?
choice:2:2:3.female: So, what do we do now?

say:0:1422621001:0.text: Come on, Magister. Let's hurry to Sal'thorin!
say:0:1422621001:0.source_cn: 主人，那我们现在直接去萨洛克兰吧。
say:0:1422621001:0.male: Come on, Magister. Let's hurry to Sal'thorin!
say:0:1422621001:0.female: Come on, Magister. Let's hurry to Sal'thorin!

say:1:1422621002:0.text: I don't think they did it on purpose...
say:1:1422621002:0.source_cn: 不过我觉得他们应该不是故意的……

say:1:1422623001:0.text: Let me go! I'm not going to serve you any longer! I'm free!
say:1:1422623001:0.source_cn: 放开我！我才不要继续伺候你了！我已经自由了！

say:2:1422623002:0.text: Need I remind you that it was my gracious decision to elevate you to my service? Were it not for my generosity, you'd never have set foot in the royal city. And now you dare think of leaving? Guards! Seize this insolent wretch at once!
say:2:1422623002:0.source_cn: 是我选了你当仆从，不然你能来王城？你不准走！喂，卫兵！...

say:3:1422623003:1.text: Calm down, both of you. Yelling won't solve anything.
say:3:1422623003:1.source_cn: 二位，都冷静下，不要在街上拉拉扯扯大喊大叫的。

say:4:1422623004:2.text: Former lord or not, the rules are plain. Everyone's equal in Sal'thorin now. Servants can choose to leave. Best accept it before you embarrass yourself.
say:4:1422623004:2.source_cn: 这位前贵族老爷，情况已经变了，仆从们可以自由选择离开。...

say:5:1422623005:0.text: Yes, I have accepted it! Being a man of honor, I complied with the new decree. I even went above and beyond, drafting a proper contract for her domestic service. And, unlike others, I had the decency to pay her wages in advance!
say:5:1422623005:0.source_cn: 我改变了啊！律法变了之后，我就与她签了家政服务的合约！...

say:6:1422623006:0.text: Yet after barely two days, this insolent wretch dares to flee! The contract is clear! If she breaks it, she must face penalties! I demand restitution!
say:6:1422623006:0.source_cn: 现在才干了两天她就要违约逃跑！至少要给违约金吧！

say:7:1422623007:2.text: Oh... Madam, is everything he said true?
say:7:1422623007:2.source_cn: 那……这位女士，请问这位前老爷说的……

say:8:1422623008:0.text: Before the law changed, I was under his thumb for years! This is just compensation for all that time I worked for free! Besides, his contract was unreasonable! I don't accept it!
say:8:1422623008:0.source_cn: 他奴役了我这么久，这只是正常给我的赔偿金！况且他那份合...

say:9:1422623009:0.text: They say you can actually make a living up on the surface now! You really think after surviving this dirt hole, I won't find work topside?!
say:9:1422623009:0.source_cn: 听说现在可以去地表上讨生活了，我就不信离开这个鬼地方，...

say:10:1422623010:0.text: At least finish cleaning my house first!
say:10:1422623010:0.source_cn: 但你至少帮我把家里打扫完了再说啊！

Okay, calm down.
Madam, has your curse been lifted?

say:12:1422623012:1.text: What are you talking about? I'm cursed?
say:12:1422623012:1.source_cn: 那是什么？我怎么还有诅咒？

say:13:1422623013:1.text: It seems you haven't read the announcement on the notice board...

say:15:1422623014:2.female: Ha! It's good to see you again, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:16:1422623015:0.male: As one of the parties responsible for all this change, it'll be easier for you to explain things.

say:19:1422623017:1.text: That's horrible... Let me reconsider everything then.

say:20:1422623018:1.source_cn: 可以边干活边想，先回我家！

say:21:1422623019:0.text: Get out of my face! I ain't working for you ever again!
say:21:1422623019:0.source_cn: 去你的吧！别想再让我给你工作了！

say:24:1422623020:0.text: Hey! Don't go! Come back! We're not done talking!
say:24:1422623020:0.source_cn: 诶！别、别走啊……我们事情还没说……完呢……

say:25:1422623021:2.text: Alright, calm down. She won't be leaving Sal'thorin any time soon. You go home and wait. We'll try mediating and see if she wants to work for you again.
say:25:1422623021:2.source_cn: 行了行了，短时间内她应该不会离开萨洛克兰，你先回家等消...

say:0:1422626001:0.female: The crowd has dispersed. Let's go talk to Indris and Ravion.

say:2:1422628002:0.text: Everyone has their own ideas yet the words they speak may carry a different tune. It doesn't help that sometimes they're at odds with themselves.
say:2:1422628002:0.source_cn: 唉，每个人都有自己的想法，但说出来的又是另一套，有时根...

say:3:1422628003:0.text: Their voices ring loud across the square, true. Yet order demands wisdom... we cannot bloody our hands each time tongues wag too freely.
say:3:1422628003:0.source_cn: 而且声音都还格外得大，为了维持秩序，我们又不能总是诉诸...

say:9:1422628008:0.text: Recent reports indicate a rise in attacks by the corrupted on Brimstone Village, and the frequency appears to be escalating.
say:9:1422628008:0.source_cn: 最近深岩村的孽化者袭击事件增多了，而且似乎还在加剧……

say:10:1422628009:1.text: Yes, the corruption... One need only recall the unseemly display in the square to see how deeply it has unsettled the people.
say:10:1422628009:1.source_cn: 孽化啊……这件事也是刚刚广场上争吵的来由。

say:11:1422628010:0.text: Though our forces are stretched thin, the distribution of Divine Dew continues without delay. The rise in corruption is concerning, but we have not let it surpass our ability to respond.
say:11:1422628010:0.source_cn: 虽说我们最近人手不足，但灵露是正常发放的。孽化者确实有...

say:12:1422628011:0.text: Our true concern lies elsewhere. After relaying my observations of the surface to the Essail, many of them developed a strong yearning for the world above.
say:12:1422628011:0.source_cn: 我们头疼的是另外一件事，我将地表的见闻分享给了艾塞勒族...

say:13:1422628012:0.text: Despite repeated warnings that the curse must be lifted before any can venture to the surface, they remain deaf to reason.
say:13:1422628012:0.source_cn: 虽然我反复强调，踏上地表的前提是解除诅咒，但是——

say:14:1422628013:0.text: The people interpret our prudent advice as coercion.
say:14:1422628013:0.source_cn: 很多人并不相信我们的忠告，反而认为这只是恐吓的手段。

say:15:1422628014:0.text: Our honesty seems only to fuel their distrust. It's beyond comprehension.
say:15:1422628014:0.source_cn: 讽刺的是，我们越是坦诚相告，质疑的声音反而越大。真是神奇啊。

choice_prompt:16:1422628014.text: Our honesty seems only to fuel their distrust. It's beyond comprehension.
choice_prompt:16:1422628014.source_cn: 讽刺的是，我们越是坦诚相告，质疑的声音反而越大。真是神奇啊。

say:17:1422628015:0.text: Taking advantage of the lack of guards, many people ignored our warnings and went to the surface on their own. As a result, their curse took effect, and they soon became corrupted.

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: （解释艾塞勒与薄暮丛林的渊源）
choice:5:0:1.male: So, the Essail and the Dark Forest...
choice:5:0:1.female: So, the Essail and the Dark Forest...

say:0:1422641001:0.text: Master Arden, do you think this is a good idea?
say:0:1422641001:0.source_cn: 雅顿老师，你这个主意真的有用吗？

say:1:1422641002:0.text: Every path must be explored if you want to reach your destination.
say:1:1422641002:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，万事都要先尝试。

say:1:1422655001:1.text: This place is really different from what I've imagined.
say:1:1422655001:1.source_cn: 这里，真是与我想象得格外不同。

say:2:1422655002:1.text: I knew this place would be unlike Sal'thorin, but the reality still took me by surprise.
say:2:1422655002:1.source_cn: 尽管我已经做过心理准备，知道此处会与萨洛克兰大相径庭，...

say:3:1422655003:1.text: Everything here is so relaxing and free...
say:3:1422655003:1.source_cn: 这里的一切都是如此的，轻松，自由而又愉快。

say:4:1422655004:1.text: There is tension as well, and disputes are not uncommon here.
say:4:1422655004:1.source_cn: 也有紧张，同样也少不了纠纷。

say:5:1422655005:1.text: Even we, in our best intentions, are not immune to the flaws of selfishness, jealousy, deception, and harm.
say:5:1422655005:1.source_cn: 自私、嫉妒、欺骗、伤害，我们并不能免俗。

say:6:1422655006:1.text: Yes, but life isn't driven by suspicion, panic, or hatred here.
say:6:1422655006:1.source_cn: 但，那并不是猜疑，恐慌与憎恨。至少不是普遍的情绪。

say:7:1422655007:1.text: If only the Essail had always been loved by Misarte, perhaps we would have known a life like this...
say:7:1422655007:1.source_cn: 如果艾塞勒也一直被弥萨忒爱着，那么，会不会……

say:8:1422655008:1.text: Apologies for my... moment of weakness. If you don't mind, I'd like to take a closer look at the Ivory Tree.
say:8:1422655008:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我失态了。我能不能走近看看皎月树？

say:9:1422655009:1.text: I'm quite curious about the guardian tree the gardener spoke of.
say:9:1422655009:1.source_cn: 花匠提到的守护之树令我很是好奇。或许……

say:1:1422658001:0.text: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Oh, Chippy and Hammie are here as well.
say:1:1422658001:0.male: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Oh, Chippy and Hammie are here as well.
say:1:1422658001:0.female: Long time no see, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Oh, Chippy and Hammie are here as well.

say:3:1422658002:1.text: Thank you kindly for your efforts, Bryon.
say:3:1422658002:1.source_cn: 这段时间辛苦你了，布莱恩。

say:4:1422658003:0.text: Ah, then you must be Captain Indris of Sal'thorin. Well met. I am Eironn.
say:4:1422658003:0.source_cn: 这位就是来自萨洛克兰的因度厄先生吗？我是埃隆。

say:5:1422658004:0.text: Please just call me Indris. And thank you for coming all this way.
say:5:1422658004:0.source_cn: 请直接称呼我为因度厄吧，埃隆。感谢你专程归来。

say:6:1422658005:1.text: Master Arden has explained your purpose in full. Given the urgency, I won't take up more time with pleasantries.
say:6:1422658005:1.source_cn: 嗯。雅顿老师已向我详述了你们的来意。事态紧急，我就不多...

say:7:1422658006:1.text: Something strange happened just now. As Indris arrived, I felt the Deer Spirit's anger, laced with deep pain and betrayal.
say:7:1422658006:1.source_cn: 有件事情很奇怪。就在因度厄抵达的瞬间，我感应到了鹿灵的...

say:8:1422658007:1.text: Betrayal? Is it because I'm an Essail?
say:8:1422658007:1.source_cn: 背叛？是因为我艾塞勒的身份吗？

say:9:1422658008:0.text: Not entirely. Your presence seems to have stirred something forbidden. The Deer Spirit's emotions shifted in an odd way, as though she recalled a past she wished to forget.
say:9:1422658008:0.source_cn: 不全是。你的出现似乎触动了某种禁忌。鹿灵情绪波动得有点...

choice_prompt:10:1422658008.text: Not entirely. Your presence seems to have stirred something forbidden. The Deer Spirit's emotions shifted in an odd way, as though she recalled a past she wished to forget.
choice_prompt:10:1422658008.source_cn: 不全是。你的出现似乎触动了某种禁忌。鹿灵的情绪波动得有点不同寻常，像是看到了一段不愿回忆的往事。

say:11:1422658009:1.text: It's hard to say for certain. I do have another theory, though. While you were exploring Ivoryshade, I took the opportunity to review more records.
say:11:1422658009:1.source_cn: 不好说。我倒是有另外的猜想——你们在月影乡游历的时候，...

say:12:1422658010:1.text: There have long been rumors of a rift between Misarte and Dura. Perhaps this anger stems from that conflict as well.
say:12:1422658010:1.source_cn: 一直以来都存在着弥萨忒与艾雅不和的传闻。或许这一愤怒也...

say:13:1422658011:1.text: Regardless of the truth, I cannot ignore the will of the Deer Spirit. There must be a reason the Essail were marked as outcasts.
say:13:1422658011:1.source_cn: 不管真相为何，我无法忽视鹿灵的意志。鹿灵将艾塞勒标记为...

say:14:1422658012:1.text: So, Indris, you arrived with the Sylvan Tendril, claiming to seek a way to save your people.
say:14:1422658012:1.source_cn: 那么，因度厄，你带着织叶而来，声称寻求解救族人的方法。

say:15:1422658013:1.text: Before I offer my aid, I must first uncover the truth of your nature and intentions.
say:15:1422658013:1.source_cn: 在我协助你之前，我得确认你真正的本质和意图。

say:17:1422658015:1.text: I believe a person's true nature is revealed most clearly in battle.
say:17:1422658015:1.source_cn: 我相信，从战斗中最能看清楚一个人的内心。

say:18:1422658016:1.text: Memories are fragile, stories are often distorted, and words can fade. Only in the crucible of battle can we truly touch each other's souls.
say:18:1422658016:1.source_cn: 记忆会偏离，叙述会美化，交谈会模糊——而战斗，是真正能...

say:19:1422658017:0.text: When two souls give everything they have, their true selves are laid bare.
say:19:1422658017:0.source_cn: 当两个人全力以赴时，彼此的本质无处可藏。

say:20:1422658018:1.text: I need to determine whether you deserve Misarte's forgiveness and if you are worthy of our trust.
say:20:1422658018:1.source_cn: 我需要确认你是否配得上弥萨忒可能的宽恕，是否值得我们的信任。

choice_prompt:21:1422658018.text: I need to determine whether you deserve Misarte's forgiveness and if you are worthy of our trust.
choice_prompt:21:1422658018.source_cn: 我需要确认你是否配得上弥萨忒可能的宽恕，是否值得我们的信任。

say:22:1422658019:0.text: I respect your judgment, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But that's not enough.
say:22:1422658019:0.male: I respect your judgment, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But that's not enough.
say:22:1422658019:0.female: I respect your judgment, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. But that's not enough.

say:23:1422658020:1.text: The Deer Spirit's response cannot be ignored. I must witness this firsthand.
say:23:1422658020:1.source_cn: 鹿灵的反应太过强烈，我必须亲自体会。

say:24:1422658021:0.text: Thank you for speaking up for me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. However, Eironn's suspicion is not without reason.
say:24:1422658021:0.male: Thank you for speaking up for me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. However, Eironn's suspicion is not without reason.
say:24:1422658021:0.female: Thank you for speaking up for me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. However, Eironn's suspicion is not without reason.

say:25:1422658022:0.text: Sal'thorin's future is at stake, and relying on the goodwill of others is not enough. I will earn his trust through my deeds.
say:25:1422658022:0.source_cn: 萨洛克兰的未来系于此行，我不能只依靠他人的善意。让我通...

choice:21:0:1.text: I can attest to Indris' honor.
choice:21:0:1.male: I can attest to Indris' honor.
choice:21:0:1.female: I can attest to Indris' honor.

choice:10:0:1.text: Related to the tainted Sylvan Egg?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 和被污染的翡绿之卵有关吗？
choice:10:0:1.male: Related to the tainted Sylvan Egg?
choice:10:0:1.female: Related to the tainted Sylvan Egg?

say:1:1422660001:0.text: A blade as sharp as steel and a will as strong as iron...
say:1:1422660001:0.source_cn: 锐利的剑术，澄澈的心灵，无比坚定的意志，以及真诚的态度。

say:2:1422660002:0.text: Regardless of how this journey ends, I believe I have gained a greater understanding of the Wilders of the Dark Forest.
say:2:1422660002:0.source_cn: 无论此行结果如何，我想我对薄暮丛林的绿裔们都有了更深刻...

say:3:1422660003:0.text: I feel the same, Indris. Your spirit blazed with courage in every blow we exchanged.
say:3:1422660003:0.source_cn: 我也同样。因度厄，你的身手强悍，坚韧，每次碰撞，我都能...

say:4:1422660004:1.text: It wasn't wild recklessness I felt from you, but the bravery of someone who's seen the worst and still chooses to move forward.
say:4:1422660004:1.source_cn: 那并非热血上头的莽撞，而是知晓一切恐怖，却仍然一往无前...

say:5:1422660005:0.text: Pardon my earlier offense. The unrest within the Deer Spirit clouded my judgment.
say:5:1422660005:0.source_cn: 请原谅我之前的无礼。鹿灵的情绪影响了我的判断。

say:6:1422660006:0.text: Now, I am certain that the Deer Spirit's rejection of you stems not from any failing of your own.
say:6:1422660006:0.source_cn: 现在我确信，鹿灵对你的排斥不可能来源于你个人的过错。

say:7:1422660007:0.text: I would like to hear more of your tale.
say:7:1422660007:0.source_cn: 我想更详细地了解你们的经历。能否从你们的角度为我讲述？

choice_prompt:8:1422660007.text: I would like to hear more of your tale.
choice_prompt:8:1422660007.source_cn: 我想更详细地了解你们的经历。能否从你们的角度为我讲述？

say:9:1422660008:1.text: The strength to face a dragon and shatter the grip of countless centuries of tyranny... such courage stirs the heart.
say:9:1422660008:1.source_cn: 能够与龙交锋，颠覆千百年来的历史与扭曲，这份勇气确实令...

say:10:1422660009:1.text: Misarte has ever cherished fairness and truth, and shall not condemn those who seek it without cause.
say:10:1422660009:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒一向重视公正与真实，不会无故责难寻求真相的人。

say:12:1422660010:1.text: Yet, her butterflies still barred the path to the Spirit Mound.
say:12:1422660010:1.source_cn: 但弥萨忒的蝴蝶仍然阻拦在圣丘之前。

say:13:1422660011:1.text: Yes, her anger and rejection still linger. I fear that speaking with the Deer Spirit alone won't be enough to find any answers.
say:13:1422660011:1.source_cn: 是的，排斥的怒火也未曾削减。看起来，只靠与鹿灵的感应无...

say:14:1422660012:1.text: Come, everyone. Let us go to the Lucent Tree. I believe it shall grant me clearer guidance.
say:14:1422660012:1.source_cn: 诸位，请随我去见流荧树吧，我相信，它会给予我更加清晰的指示。

say:16:1422660013:1.text: I shall not accompany you for now. There is an old friend whose whispers I must heed first...
say:16:1422660013:1.source_cn: 我想我就暂时不跟你们同行了，我得去倾听一位老朋友的低语了……

choice:8:0:1.text: The Essail, the dragon, and Sal'thorin...
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: （讲述艾塞勒、龙和萨洛克兰的故事）
choice:8:0:1.male: The Essail, the dragon, and Sal'thorin...
choice:8:0:1.female: The Essail, the dragon, and Sal'thorin...

say:0:1422661001:0.text: Master Arden's words always carry layers of hidden meaning.
say:0:1422661001:0.source_cn: 雅顿老师的话，有些深意啊。

say:1:1422661002:0.text: He has always been like this. Let us head to the Lucent Tree.
say:1:1422661002:0.source_cn: 老师向来如此，我们还是先去流荧树那里吧。

say:1:1422662001:1.text: So, this is the Lucent Tree... It's truly a sight to behold.
say:1:1422662001:1.source_cn: 这就是守护薄暮丛林的流荧树吗……真是让人震撼。

say:2:1422662002:1.text: Indeed, this is the Lucent Tree, the very heart of the Dark Forest, the sacred tree blessed by Misarte herself.
say:2:1422662002:1.source_cn: 这就是流荧树，薄暮丛林的中心，弥萨忒祝福之树。

say:3:1422662003:1.text: Now, I shall commune with the Lucent Tree and await the guidance of Misarte.
say:3:1422662003:1.source_cn: 接下来，我会与流荧树感应，聆听弥萨忒的指引。

say:4:1422662004:1.text: However, it takes some time to communicate with the Lucent Tree.
say:4:1422662004:1.source_cn: 只是，与流荧树的沟通需要花些时间。

say:5:1422662005:1.text: I don't mind waiting. My people waited a thousand years to learn of the curse. A little longer means nothing now.
say:5:1422662005:1.source_cn: 我不介意等待，知晓诅咒之事都已花了千年，何况这一息时间。

say:6:1422662006:1.text: Rest easy, Indris. Eironn stands as the Scion of the Lucent Tree, chosen and blessed by the divine.
say:6:1422662006:1.source_cn: 因度厄，放心吧。埃隆是流荧树之子，深受眷顾。

say:7:1422662007:1.text: Don't mention my title. It's embarrassing.

choice_prompt:8:1422662007.text: Don't mention my title. It's embarrassing.

say:10:1422662009:1.text: You deserve the title. No one understands the Lucent Tree better than you.
say:10:1422662009:1.source_cn: 流荧树之子名副其实，毕竟没人比你更能理解它的意志。

say:11:1422662012:1.text: Alright, allow me a moment to focus. Please wait here while I commune with the Lucent Tree.
say:11:1422662012:1.source_cn: ……我还是专注正事吧。请大家在这里稍作等待，我去与流荧...

choice:8:0:1.text: It's a nice title to have.
choice:8:0:1.male: It's a nice title to have.
choice:8:0:1.female: It's a nice title to have.

say:13:1422662010:1.text: Finally, someone understands. This title feels so overblown... like I'm meant to be some kind of mythic figure.
say:13:1422662010:1.source_cn: 总算有人理解我的感受。这称号听起来太夸张了，好像我是什...

say:15:1422662011:1.text: Chippy thinks it's super cool! Scion of the Lucent Tree! Savior of the Dark Forest! Like a hero out of a legend!
say:15:1422662011:1.source_cn: 满满觉得挺酷的！流荧树之子！听起来就超厉害！

say:0:1422663001:0.text: Eironn needs quiet to commune—so no disturbances. Yes, Chippy, that means you.
say:0:1422663001:0.source_cn: 埃隆需要安静的环境维持对流荧树的感应，不要打扰他了吧。
say:0:1422663001:0.male: Eironn needs quiet to commune—so no disturbances. Yes, Chippy, that means you.
say:0:1422663001:0.female: Eironn needs quiet to commune—so no disturbances. Yes, Chippy, that means you.

narration:0:1422664001:1.text: You all wait nearby, hoping for an answer from Eironn...

say:0:1422665001:0.text: It's done... Misarte's will has spoken, and all has been revealed to me.
say:0:1422665001:0.source_cn: 完成了……弥萨忒留下的意志已然将一切传达于我。

say:1:1422666001:1.text: First and foremost, Misarte's anger stems from the defiance of her sacred will.
say:1:1422666001:1.source_cn: 首先，关于弥萨忒的怒火来由，是在于违逆神意。

say:2:1422666002:1.text: During the Divine War, it was Misarte's will to stay apart from the conflicts of the world, choosing instead the peace found in the shelter of forests and mountains.
say:2:1422666002:1.source_cn: 对于神魔战争，弥萨忒的意志是远离纷争与战火——在丛林与...

say:3:1422666003:1.text: However, the Sages of that era disregarded this sacred request, choosing instead to offer the power of the Sylvan Egg to Dura and the humans when faced with the war.
say:3:1422666003:1.source_cn: 但当年的贤者们无视了这份嘱托，在面对参战的艾雅与人类一...

say:4:1422666004:1.text: And nearly the entire forest was drawn into the war, and this was the primary cause for Misarte's fury.
say:4:1422666004:1.source_cn: 几乎将整片丛林卷入战火之中——这才是弥萨忒愤怒的主因。

say:6:1422666005:1.text: In other words, the corruption of the Sylvan Egg and the ensuing conflict weren't the main reasons. They merely served to fuel the fire.
say:6:1422666005:1.source_cn: 也就是说，翡绿之卵的被污染与后续的冲突，并不是起因，而...

say:7:1422666006:1.text: Yes, that's why Misarte's punishment was so severe.
say:7:1422666006:1.source_cn: 是的，所以弥萨忒的惩戒才会那样严苛。

say:8:1422666007:1.text: Just as she had severed the corrupted parts away from the Sylvan Egg, she too severed your people from the Wilders.
say:8:1422666007:1.source_cn: 祂将那些人剥离了，正如将翡绿之卵被污染的部分剥离了一样。

say:10:1422666008:0.text: Do you mean that the curse was used to banish us from the Dark Forest?
say:10:1422666008:0.source_cn: 剥离……那是指用诅咒将我们从薄暮丛林驱逐吗？

say:11:1422666009:0.text: Yes, it was used to sever our ties.
say:11:1422666009:0.source_cn: 嗯，事实上，那是剥离的一部分。

say:12:1422666010:1.text: Through Misarte's blessing, her people are woven into the very fabric of nature, their blood intertwined with the rivers and forests.
say:12:1422666010:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒的子民因祂的祝福，而天然同河川与森林有着血脉相连...

say:13:1422666011:1.text: Misarte caused all the rivers and forests within her domain to turn away from the cursed Wilders.
say:13:1422666011:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒的剥离，让所有祂掌管的河川与森林都在排斥着被诅咒...

say:14:1422666012:1.text: So the ground beneath their feet became a bed of knives, and the waters they drank scorched like magma.
say:14:1422666012:1.source_cn: 因此踏在地上，犹如踏在刀锋之上。饮下清水，犹如饮下岩浆。

say:16:1422666013:1.text: They were cast out from Misarte's domain, no longer welcomed among her children.
say:16:1422666013:1.source_cn: 在弥萨忒的领域，不再容忍他们涉足——就是这样的意思。

say:18:1422666014:1.text: Then why were the Essail able to settle in Sal'thorin?
say:18:1422666014:1.source_cn: 唔，那这样的话，为什么艾塞勒到了萨洛克兰就能暂时安定下来呢？

choice_prompt:19:1422666014.text: Then why were the Essail able to settle in Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:19:1422666014.source_cn: 唔，那这样的话，为什么艾塞勒到了萨洛克兰就能暂时安定下来呢？

say:20:1422666015:1.text: Yes, the world underground does not belong to Misarte.
say:20:1422666015:1.source_cn: 是哦，地底区域并不属于弥萨忒。

say:21:1422666017:1.text: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.
say:21:1422666017:1.source_cn: 那主人用织叶解除诅咒，就像是借用拥有弥萨忒之力翡绿之卵...
say:21:1422666017:1.male: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.
say:21:1422666017:1.female: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.

say:22:1422666018:1.text: The Sylvan Egg surely holds the power to lift the curse, but doing so would mean bypassing Misarte's authority and using magic directly to break it.
say:22:1422666018:1.source_cn: 但是，这只是主人作为梅林的代行，弥萨忒本人并没有解除惩罚。

say:23:1422666019:1.text: So when Indris entered Misarte's realm, the Mysalind and the butterflies blocked his path, and the Deer Spirit grew angry. Is this why? Because we sidestepped her authority?
say:23:1422666019:1.source_cn: 所以在因度厄出现在弥萨忒的领域时，迈萨林德和蝴蝶会阻拦...

choice_prompt:24:1422666019.text: So when Indris entered Misarte's realm, the Mysalind and the butterflies blocked his path, and the Deer Spirit grew angry. Is this why? Because we sidestepped her authority?
choice_prompt:24:1422666019.source_cn: 所以在因度厄出现在弥萨忒的领域时，迈萨林德和蝴蝶会阻拦，鹿灵会愤怒，是因为这个吗？

say:26:1422666020:1.text: There are still things we can't fully explain, but at least some of the concerns have been put to rest.
say:26:1422666020:1.source_cn: 还是有一些无法解释的事，但至少能覆盖一部分疑惑了。

say:27:1422666022:1.text: I see. After hearing all that, I can see why Misarte is so angry.
say:27:1422666022:1.source_cn: 在你们的解释后，我大概能理解弥萨忒的愤怒。

say:28:1422666023:1.text: But with the war spreading, as a major power in these lands, could we really have just stood aside?
say:28:1422666023:1.source_cn: 但面对蔓延的战火，作为大陆的一员，是否真的能独善其身？

say:29:1422666024:1.text: What followed was a great Divine War that swept across Esperia...
say:29:1422666024:1.source_cn: 后续可是席卷伊索米亚大陆的神魔战争啊……

say:30:1422666025:1.text: Although I don't agree with some of the decisions made by Sage Tasso and Seralyth in the past, during that war, when the world was at risk, could we afford to do nothing?
say:30:1422666025:1.source_cn: 尽管我不认同塔萨贤者和奈萨雷斯之前的一些决策，但在那场...

say:31:1422666026:1.text: Therefore, I don't believe my ancestors were wrong in choosing to go to war.
say:31:1422666026:1.source_cn: 所以，我并不认为我的先祖在选择参战上犯了错。

say:32:1422666027:1.text: As for the corruption of the Sylvan Egg, it was indeed their fault... No, our fault.
say:32:1422666027:1.source_cn: 至于翡绿之卵被污染之事，确实是他们……不，我们的过错。

say:33:1422666028:1.text: But we've paid the price for two thousand years. Surely, that's more than enough punishment, isn't it?
say:33:1422666028:1.source_cn: 但我们也为此付出了两千年的代价。这样的惩罚，难道还不够吗？

say:35:1422666029:1.text: Indris, the gods see the world differently from mortals. To Misarte, this isn't simply punishment. It was also necessary to safeguard her people.
say:35:1422666029:1.source_cn: 因度厄，神明的思维与凡人不同。对弥萨忒而言，这不仅是惩...

say:36:1422666030:1.text: Since you believe your ancestors made the right choice, then show the resolve needed to face <style="highlight">Misarte's trial</style>.
say:36:1422666030:1.source_cn: 既然你认为先祖的选择无错，那就拿出相应的决心来接受<s...

say:37:1422666031:1.text: If you seek Misarte's forgiveness, you must find the strength within yourself to renew your bond with the earth and the mountains.
say:37:1422666031:1.source_cn: 如果你想得到弥萨忒的宽恕，就必须凭借自己的力量，与大地...

say:38:1422666032:1.text: Only by proving your understanding of Misarte's will can you receive her guidance and find the path to resolve the plight of your people.
say:38:1422666032:1.source_cn: 只有证明你们已经理解了弥萨忒的意志，才能让祂降下新的指...

say:40:1422666034:1.text: Very well, Misarte's messengers will guide your path.
say:40:1422666034:1.source_cn: 别担心，弥萨忒的使者将会指引你的道路。

say:43:1422666021:1.text: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.
say:43:1422666021:1.source_cn: 毕竟弥萨忒本人没有答应，但梅林凭借力量解决了，确实算是作弊。
say:43:1422666021:1.male: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.
say:43:1422666021:1.female: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.

choice:24:1:2.text: Did I cheat with my power?
choice:24:1:2.male: Did I cheat with my power?
choice:24:1:2.female: Did I cheat with my power?

say:44:1422666016:1.text: That's right. It's under Helthor's domain, not Misarte's.
say:44:1422666016:1.source_cn: 对哦，那里毕竟是赫托的领域所在，也不是弥萨忒的地域。

choice:19:1:2.text: Could be due to Helthor's power.
choice:19:1:2.male: Could be due to Helthor's power.
choice:19:1:2.female: Could be due to Helthor's power.

say:0:1422667001:0.text: The blue butterflies have appeared. Misarte is willing to guide you.
say:0:1422667001:0.source_cn: 蓝色闪蝶出现了，弥萨忒正在用祂的信使指引着你。

say:0:1422669001:0.text: Greetings, I've been waiting for you all.
say:0:1422669001:0.source_cn: 你们好……我想你……们是来找我的。

say:1:1422670001:1.text: Before you came, the Taran River had already carried the Deer Spirit's message to me through its current.
say:1:1422670001:1.source_cn: 在你们到来之前……塔兰河……已经用它的水流……向我传达...

say:2:1422670002:1.text: The banished one must enter the river—let it wash over his journeying body.
say:2:1422670002:1.source_cn: 被、被驱逐的子民……需要将远行的躯体……浸入河川当中。

say:3:1422670003:1.text: Cleanse what's been tainted... reconnect what was once severed from the water's flow.
say:3:1422670003:1.source_cn: 洁净身躯……将已然断绝的联系……与水脉重新接续。

choice_prompt:4:1422670003.text: Cleanse what's been tainted... reconnect what was once severed from the water's flow.
choice_prompt:4:1422670003.source_cn: 洁净身躯……将已然断绝的联系……与水脉重新接续。

say:5:1422670004:1.text: The Taran River is merciful. It will lift him gently.
say:5:1422670004:1.source_cn: 塔兰河……很仁慈……会温柔地托举他的身躯……

say:7:1422670006:1.text: N-no, that won't... I will find another way if needed!
say:7:1422670006:1.source_cn: 不、不过那时……我会想办法！

say:8:1422670008:1.text: To truly reconnect will be painful...
say:8:1422670008:1.source_cn: 浸入到河流中……会感到痛苦……

say:9:1422670009:1.source_cn: 重现连接……就像……就像将断掉的肢体重续……

say:10:1422670010:1.text: You'll have to endure the pain of the water and open your heart to it.
say:10:1422670010:1.source_cn: 必须……要承受住河水带来的痛楚……同时……敞开心扉……

say:11:1422670011:1.text: No matter how painful, I'll accept it.
say:11:1422670011:1.source_cn: 不论有多痛苦，我都会接受。

say:12:1422670012:1.text: There's one more thing. The river... judges your heart. Don't try to deceive it.
say:12:1422670012:1.source_cn: 还有一点……河流……会检验你的内心。不、不要瞒着它……

say:14:1422670013:1.text: This is Misarte's trial. She must confirm you understand the weight of defying divine will.
say:14:1422670013:1.source_cn: 这是弥萨忒的考验。祂要确认你是否理解了当初违背神意的后果。

say:15:1422670014:1.text: I don't believe our ancestors were wrong, but I'll bear responsibility for our people. I'll show Misarte my resolve.
say:15:1422670014:1.source_cn: 我并不认为祖先们的选择有错，但我愿意为族人承担责任。我...

say:16:1422670015:1.text: Don't be afraid. The Taran River won't harm you, even if it hurts. And I'll stand guard.
say:16:1422670015:1.source_cn: 不要……害怕……虽然痛苦……但塔兰河不会伤害……我会…...

say:19:1422670007:1.text: N-no... just soaking in the river doesn't make it a trial.
say:19:1422670007:1.source_cn: 是、是的……如果只是泡在河里……是无法构成考验的。

say:1:1422672001:1.text: I can feel it. Your soul and the river... your blood... they're one again.
say:1:1422672001:1.source_cn: 我感觉到了……河流和你的灵魂……血脉……重新连接在了一起……

say:2:1422672002:0.text: Wherever you go, the aqua leylines of your homeland will follow.
say:2:1422672002:0.source_cn: 从此……无论你前往何处……故乡的水脉都将与你相连……

say:5:1422672004:0.text: I'm fine. Just a bit of residual pain, it's already fading.
say:5:1422672004:0.source_cn: 还好，只是还有点疼的感觉残留，已经没事了。

say:6:1422672006:0.text: Now that the river's trial is complete, please tell me what the next one is.
say:6:1422672006:0.source_cn: 那么，河川的考验已经结束，请告诉我下一项考验是什么吧。

say:7:1422672007:0.text: You're in bad shape. You really shouldn't move yet.
say:7:1422672007:0.source_cn: 你现在的身体状况……很、很糟糕。

say:8:1422672008:0.text: It's best not to move. Why don't you rest for a while?
say:8:1422672008:0.source_cn: 最好不要活动……要休息……否则……

say:10:1422672009:0.text: Indris, this recklessness serves no one!
say:10:1422672009:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你这样只是在伤害自己的身体！

say:11:1422672010:0.text: Another trial now? You'd fall to a child's blow in this state!
say:11:1422672010:0.source_cn: 你现在别说接受考验了，就算普通的战斗恐怕也举步维艰！

say:12:1422672011:0.text: Thank you. I appreciate your concern, but...
say:12:1422672011:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们。你们的好意我非常明白，只是……

say:13:1422672012:0.text: This pain is nothing compared to the torment of corruption.
say:13:1422672012:0.source_cn: 只是这份痛苦，对于孽化来说，并不算什么。

say:15:1422672014:0.text: Many in Sal'thorin still suffer under the curse's agony.
say:15:1422672014:0.source_cn: 萨洛克兰的许多人，此刻仍然在诅咒与孽化交织的苦痛中沉沦。

say:16:1422672015:0.text: The sooner I act, the more I can save.
say:16:1422672015:0.source_cn: 如果我能提前一些，那么就会有越多人得到拯救。

say:17:1422672016:0.text: Earlier, Hewynn said the waters of my homeland are connected to me now.
say:17:1422672016:0.source_cn: 刚刚，伊温小姐说，故乡的水脉从此与我相连。

say:18:1422672017:0.text: Yet... forgive my ingratitude... when I think of "home", I still see Sal'thorin.
say:18:1422672017:0.source_cn: 但，或许是我不识抬举吧……在提到故乡的时候，我眼前浮现...

say:19:1422672018:0.text: I must save it. Change it. That's why I stand here.
say:19:1422672018:0.source_cn: 我想要去拯救它，改变它。这也是我站在此处的理由。

say:20:1422672019:0.text: So please, Eironn—tell me what the next trial is.
say:20:1422672019:0.source_cn: 所以，请告诉我下一项考验是什么吧，埃隆。

say:21:1422672020:0.text: ... Stubborn as mountain oak. But the next one won't be easier.
say:21:1422672020:0.source_cn: ……真是固执。我先警告你，接下来的考验并不会更容易。

say:22:1422672021:0.text: Then all the more reason not to waste time. Let's go.
say:22:1422672021:0.source_cn: 那就更不能浪费时间了，走吧。

say:24:1422672005:0.text: It's already getting better. I'll recover soon.
say:24:1422672005:0.source_cn: 当时是有些疼，但现在已经好多了，很快就可以恢复正常。

say:0:1422673001:0.text: It's Misarte's messenger. Let's follow it.
say:0:1422673001:0.source_cn: 又出现了，弥萨忒的使者，我们跟上去吧。

say:1:1422674002:0.text: Master Arden, you're as cunning as ever.

say:1:1422675001:1.text: The Deer Spirit has witnessed your deeds and reveals your next path.
say:1:1422675001:1.source_cn: 诸位，你们所做的一切，鹿灵都已知晓。

say:2:1422675002:1.text: She will now lead us to the next trial: bonding with the geo leylines.
say:2:1422675002:1.source_cn: 而祂也予以指引，此处则是考验的下一步——与地脉建立联系。

say:3:1422675003:1.text: To connect with the aqua leylines, he soaked in the river. So, to bond with the geo leylines... he doesn't need to bury himself, does he?
say:3:1422675003:1.source_cn: 与水脉联系要泡到河里，与地脉联系，总不能是挖个坑埋了吧？

say:4:1422675004:1.text: Haha! No, no such drastic measures. The Taran River's trial was to prove his worthiness of redemption.
say:4:1422675004:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，不用不用，浸入水中，是塔兰河的考验——为了证明...

say:5:1422675005:1.text: Now that Indris has shown his sincerity, we've reached the stage of true redemption.
say:5:1422675005:1.source_cn: 而在因度厄证明自身的诚意之后，此处则是赎罪的部分了。

say:6:1422675006:1.text: The Vaduso Mountains once flourished under Misarte's grace, their leylines whole.
say:6:1422675006:1.source_cn: 本来整个瓦度索山脉都处于弥萨忒的庇佑下，地脉也并无损坏。

say:7:1422675007:1.text: But Eomir's sins corrupted and polluted Rainford. It's been cut off from the earth.
say:7:1422675007:1.source_cn: 可之前伊米尔在此处造下罪孽，让沐霖村被腐化污染。这里已...

say:8:1422675008:1.text: Indris must bring Rainford back into Misarte's embrace.
say:8:1422675008:1.source_cn: 现在需要因度厄协助，让沐霖村回归弥萨忒的怀抱。

say:9:1422675009:1.source_cn: 多么顺理成章的考验啊……

say:10:1422675010:1.text: Ahem. Let's call it a win-win.

say:11:1422675011:1.text: What do I need to do?
say:11:1422675011:1.source_cn: 理应如此。请问，我需要怎么做？

say:12:1422675012:1.text: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.
say:12:1422675012:1.male: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.
say:12:1422675012:1.female: Truthfully, <style="stress"><player_name></style> did half the work already.

say:13:1422675013:1.text: He's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.
say:13:1422675013:1.source_cn: 原本这个考验最艰难的就是驱逐邪恶的污染与腐化，但梅林已...
say:13:1422675013:1.male: He's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.
say:13:1422675013:1.female: She's already taken care of the hardest part—purifying the corruption. Now we only need to relink the leylines.

say:14:1422675014:1.text: But Eomir's experiments drained the magic in the local geo leyline.
say:14:1422675014:1.source_cn: 问题只在于，由于伊米尔的实验，这里地脉的魔力遭到过度抽...

say:15:1422675015:1.source_cn: 必须要<style=highlight>纯净的土元素精...

say:18:1422675017:1.text: That's the tricky part. The corruption lingers. Pure earth essence is rare in the Vaduso Mountains.
say:18:1422675017:1.source_cn: 这倒是有点难了，腐化的影响尚未消除彻底。瓦度索山脉虽有...

say:19:1422675018:1.text: Earth elementals... Sal'thorin has plenty of <style="highlight">stone wardens</style>—we might be able to draw essence from them.
say:19:1422675018:1.source_cn: ……土元素，萨洛克兰有很多土元素。或许能在那里找到纯净...

say:21:1422675019:1.text: Good idea. You'll need to act fast.
say:21:1422675019:1.source_cn: 这确实是个主意，但你们的行动要快。

say:23:1422675020:2.text: I'll also go help—I mean supervise. As Misarte's witness, I must ensure nothing goes wrong.
say:23:1422675020:2.source_cn: 我也去帮……我也去监督，作为弥萨忒的见证人，我要确保不...

choice_prompt:24:1422675020.text: I'll also go help—I mean supervise. As Misarte's witness, I must ensure nothing goes wrong.
choice_prompt:24:1422675020.source_cn: 我也去帮……我也去监督，作为弥萨忒的见证人，我要确保不会出什么问题。

say:25:1422675021:1.text: I-I won't interfere! This is Indris' trial. I'm just... observing!
say:25:1422675021:1.source_cn: 呃……我不会帮忙的，这是因度厄的考验，而我是弥萨忒的代...

say:26:1422675023:1.text: Please go ahead. I'll start locating a site where we can reconnect the geo leylines.
say:26:1422675023:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵，那么，去吧，我会在这里，先找到适合修复的地脉节点。

say:27:1422675024:1.text: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.
say:27:1422675024:1.source_cn: 此外，梅林，我可能要借用你的小使魔一段时间。
say:27:1422675024:1.male: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.
say:27:1422675024:1.female: Also, Merlin, I might need to borrow your familiars for a bit.

say:29:1422675025:1.text: Restoring the local connection is only part of the work. I plan to use this opportunity to reorganize the entire leyline structure here.
say:29:1422675025:1.source_cn: 重建地域的联系只是一部分工作，我想借机把此处的地脉整体...

say:30:1422675026:1.text: If this can mark the beginning of Sal'thorin's recovery, we can deepen this region's harmony.
say:30:1422675026:1.source_cn: 如果能借着萨洛克兰一支回归为契机，让这一带区域深度融合...

say:31:1422675027:0.text: Bryon can handle outside surveillance, but your two familiars have impressed me with their understanding of the local leylines.
say:31:1422675027:0.source_cn: 布莱恩能够负责外围的探查，但论起对此处地脉的理解，你的...

choice_prompt:32:1422675027.text: Bryon can handle outside surveillance, but your two familiars have impressed me with their understanding of the local leylines.
choice_prompt:32:1422675027.source_cn: 布莱恩能够负责外围的探查，但论起对此处地脉的理解，你的两位使魔可是给我留下了很深刻的印象。

say:34:1422675028:1.text: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...
say:34:1422675028:1.source_cn: 唔，还是想多和主人一起行动……
say:34:1422675028:1.male: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...
say:34:1422675028:1.female: Hmm... Chippy would rather stay with you, Magister...

say:35:1422675029:1.text: But it's true that we can be more useful here.
say:35:1422675029:1.source_cn: 不过，对这一带的地脉，确实我和满满更能派上用场。

say:36:1422675030:0.text: Then, please be careful on your journey!
say:36:1422675030:0.source_cn: 那，主人路上一定要多小心呀！
say:36:1422675030:0.male: Then, please be careful on your journey!
say:36:1422675030:0.female: Then, please be careful on your journey!

choice:32:0:1.text: Are you two okay with that?
choice:32:0:1.male: Are you two okay with that?
choice:32:0:1.female: Are you two okay with that?

say:40:1422675022:1.text: I said nothing! I'll just be there to observe... really.
say:40:1422675022:1.source_cn: 我什么都没说，我也不会帮忙，只是去见证下情况……真的。

narration:1:1422675101:0.text: Once again, you all board Evie's ship and, with a strange mix of emotions, return to Sal'thorin.
narration:1:1422675101:0.source_cn: 你们再次乘上了伊芙的大船，带着奇妙的心境暂时返回了萨洛...

say:0:1422675501:0.text: So... this is your homeland, Sal'thorin?
say:0:1422675501:0.source_cn: 这里……就是你的家乡萨洛克兰吗？

say:1:1422675502:0.source_cn: 是的，我的家乡萨洛克兰。

say:1:1422677001:1.text: I thought I'd seen everything in my travels... but Sal'thorin is unlike anything I've known.
say:1:1422677001:1.source_cn: 我本以为游历四方后已经见识匪浅了。但从没见过萨洛克兰这...

say:2:1422677002:1.text: Its architecture doesn't resemble the Dark Forest. It actually reminds me more of the Lightbearer Empire.
say:2:1422677002:1.source_cn: 这里的建筑风格和薄暮丛林完全不一样，倒是有一些耀光的感觉。

say:3:1422677003:1.text: We build with trees, shaping homes to nature's flow. Not like this... grandeur.
say:3:1422677003:1.source_cn: 我们的居所都是与树木共生，随自然而建，并不像萨洛克兰这...

say:4:1422677004:1.text: Sal'thorin was built with help from the dwarves. That may explain it.
say:4:1422677004:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰是由矮人一族协助建造的，可能这是原因之一吧。

say:5:1422677005:1.text: As for grandeur... perhaps it reflects a belief in order and structure.
say:5:1422677005:1.source_cn: 至于壮观……或许这也是一种秩序和界限的体现。

say:6:1422677006:1.text: Order? That's an interesting way to put it. In the Dark Forest, nature is our order—not walls or roads.
say:6:1422677006:1.source_cn: 秩序和界限吗？有趣的说法。在薄暮丛林，我们的秩序是自然...

say:7:1422677007:1.text: Yet seeing Sal'thorin now, compared to what you described before...
say:7:1422677007:1.source_cn: 不过，看到萨洛克兰现在的变化，再对比你们之前描述的情况。

say:8:1422677008:1.text: I just wish I had more time to learn about your home.
say:8:1422677008:1.source_cn: 我只是有一些遗憾，不能再更深入地了解你们。

say:9:1422677009:1.text: This trial leaves me no time to show Sal'thorin properly.
say:9:1422677009:1.source_cn: 这次考验在身上，不能带你好好浏览萨洛克兰。

say:10:1422677010:1.text: But if the curse is lifted, I'll take you through every street, every corner of my city.
say:10:1422677010:1.source_cn: 如果……诅咒真能解除，我一定会带着你好好看看我的家乡。

say:0:1422677101:0.text: This district is so different from the royal city. Life here has an entirely different rhythm.
say:0:1422677101:0.source_cn: 这里跟王城内差异好大，生活看起来完全不一样。

say:1:1422677102:0.text: That's why the old system held on for so long. But change is already taking root.
say:1:1422677102:0.source_cn: 这也是之前的制度根深蒂固的原因，不过一切已经在改变了。

say:0:1422678001:0.text: Those huge glowing mushrooms... I've never seen anything like them.
say:0:1422678001:0.source_cn: 那些发光的巨型蘑菇……我从未见过这种规模的菌类。

say:1:1422678002:0.text: Subterranean flora, thriving without the sun...
say:1:1422678002:0.source_cn: 地底的植物，没有阳光却依然顽强生长……甚至演化出了独特...

say:1:1422682001:0.text: Thank you! I thought I was done for...
say:1:1422682001:0.source_cn: 谢、谢谢，吓死我了，还以为这次彻底完蛋了呢……

say:2:1422682002:0.source_cn: 您、您不是因度厄大人吗！太感谢了！

say:3:1422682003:0.text: Why are there Sinned Ones here? Where are the guards?
say:3:1422682003:0.source_cn: ……这里怎么也会有孽化者出现？卫兵们没有在附近巡逻吗？

say:4:1422682004:1.text: I don't know! I thought this area was safe!
say:4:1422682004:1.source_cn: 我、我不知道啊！我也是想着这里肯定安全，才出来弄吃的。

say:5:1422682005:1.text: Ravion wouldn't neglect his duties. Either the guards are stretched too thin...
say:5:1422682005:1.source_cn: 沙利叶不至于在这种事上玩忽职守，恐怕是防守的人手不够……

say:6:1422682006:1.text: ...or the corruption has gotten worse than we feared.
say:6:1422682006:1.source_cn: ……也可能是孽化的情况更严重了。

say:7:1422682007:1.text: Go find Ravion and tell him clearly what happened—and that you saw me.
say:7:1422682007:1.source_cn: 你回去找沙利叶，把遇袭和见到我的事情跟他说清楚。

say:8:1422682008:1.source_cn: 好、好的。因度厄大人，我先过去！

say:11:1422682009:1.text: That creature we fought... was that a corrupted Essail?
say:11:1422682009:1.source_cn: 因度厄，刚刚我们面对的那个怪物，就是你们提到的孽化的…...

say:12:1422682010:1.text: Yes. First, the scales appear, then the limbs twist... and then reason burns away.
say:12:1422682010:1.source_cn: 是的，一开始长出鳞片，接着肢体扭曲，最终连理智都烧尽了……

say:15:1422682013:1.text: Compared to that, the pain from the Taran River is nothing.
say:15:1422682013:1.source_cn: 所以，比起被塔兰河冲刷的痛苦来说，孽化才是真正的折磨。

say:16:1422682014:1.text: To me, the corruption is more than just a curse. I see it as divine retribution for our sins against the dragons... for our greed and theft.
say:16:1422682014:1.source_cn: 孽化，除了诅咒外，也可以说是龙对我们的窃取与贪婪的惩戒吧。

say:17:1422682015:1.text: This is their punishment and Misarte's.
say:17:1422682015:1.source_cn: 龙的惩戒，弥萨忒的惩戒……

say:18:1422682016:1.text: We Essail drown beneath twin condemnations.
say:18:1422682016:1.source_cn: 我们艾塞勒最终在两种惩戒交织下沉沦。

say:19:1422682017:1.text: Which is why I must hurry. Who knows how many more will suffer if I don't?
say:19:1422682017:1.source_cn: ……所以，我必须要加快脚步，否则，不知道还有多少人会继...

say:20:1422682018:1.text: ... Understood. The earth essence takes priority.
say:20:1422682018:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。我们去找纯净的土元素吧。时间不等人。

say:0:1422684001:0.text: A stone warden! Let's subdue it.
say:0:1422684001:0.source_cn: 找到巨岩之灵了，先制服它再说。
say:0:1422684001:0.male: A stone warden! Let's subdue it.
say:0:1422684001:0.female: A stone warden! Let's subdue it.

say:0:1422685001:0.source_cn: 开始提取纯净的土元素精华吧。

narration:1:1422687001:0.text: With heavy hearts and growing urgency, you all hurry back to Rainford.
narration:1:1422687001:0.source_cn: 怀着沉重又焦急的心情，你们迅速地赶回到了沐霖村。

say:1:1422688001:1.text: Judging by your faces, I assume you got the essence?
say:1:1422688001:1.source_cn: 各位，看你们的样子，应该获取到了纯净的土元素精华？

say:3:1422688003:1.text: With the familiars' aid, I've pinpointed the leyline nexus.
say:3:1422688003:1.source_cn: 我在两位使魔的协助下，也找到了地脉节点。

say:4:1422688004:1.text: Restoring the geo leyline might shift things. I've already asked Bryon to monitor the other nexuses—he'll alert us if anything goes wrong.
say:4:1422688004:1.source_cn: 修复地脉后，此地可能会有一些变化。我已经安排了布莱恩在...

say:5:1422688005:1.text: The rest is up to you. It shouldn't be too difficult.
say:5:1422688005:1.source_cn: 剩下的就交给你们了。此事并不难——

say:6:1422688006:1.text: Just let the earth essence merge into the geo leyline, and it will repair itself and reconnect with the other nexuses.
say:6:1422688006:1.source_cn: 只需让土元素精华融入地脉中，它们就能修复并与其他地脉节...

choice_prompt:7:1422688006.text: Just let the earth essence merge into the geo leyline, and it will repair itself and reconnect with the other nexuses.
choice_prompt:7:1422688006.source_cn: 只需让土元素精华融入地脉中，它们就能修复并与其他地脉节点连接。

say:8:1422688007:1.text: Then, Merlin, inject the essence here...
say:8:1422688007:1.source_cn: 那么梅林，将土元素精华在此注入……
say:8:1422688007:1.male: Then, Merlin, inject the essence here...
say:8:1422688007:1.female: Then, Merlin, inject the essence here...

narration:0:1422689001:0.text: You pour the essence into the leyline beneath Rainford, but it refuses to merge with or heal the land...
narration:0:1422689001:0.source_cn: 你将土元素精华注入了沐霖村的地脉之中，但精华并没有融合...

say:1:1422690001:0.text: By all logic, earth essence should be naturally drawn to leyline nexuses. The moment it senses one, it ought to merge right away.
say:1:1422690001:0.source_cn: 照理说，土元素精华天生亲近地脉……一旦感应到地脉节点，...

say:2:1422690002:0.text: Especially here, where the leyline's dried out—this kind of place is usually perfect for restoring balance. So... why isn't it reacting?
say:2:1422690002:0.source_cn: 尤其此处地脉魔力干涸，更是它们最喜欢生存调和之处，为什...

choice_prompt:3:1422690002.text: Especially here, where the leyline's dried out—this kind of place is usually perfect for restoring balance. So... why isn't it reacting?
choice_prompt:3:1422690002.source_cn: 尤其此处地脉魔力干涸，更是它们最喜欢生存调和之处，为什么会没有反应呢？

say:4:1422690003:0.text: That would explain it. Coming from a different leyline, it can't immediately repair something it's never been part of.
say:4:1422690003:0.source_cn: 有道理，有道理。毕竟是来自不同的地脉，面对陌生之地，自...

say:5:1422690004:0.text: If that's the case, we'll need someone to <style="highlight">act as the bridge</style>, establishing a blood connection before the earth essence flows into the leyline nexus.
say:5:1422690004:0.source_cn: 既然如此，我们就得借助<style=highlight...

say:6:1422690005:1.text: A bridge...? Master Arden, do you mean... Indris?
say:6:1422690005:1.source_cn: 人之桥梁？老师，你是说因度厄吗？

say:7:1422690006:0.text: Not only him. You as well, Eironn. And Merlin's magic will be key to the process.
say:7:1422690006:0.source_cn: 不仅是他，还有你，埃隆。当然，梅林的力量也不可或缺。
say:7:1422690006:0.male: Not only him. You as well, Eironn. And Merlin's magic will be key to the process.
say:7:1422690006:0.female: Not only him. You as well, Eironn. And Merlin's magic will be key to the process.

say:8:1422690007:0.text: Eironn, you'll call upon the leyline here in Misarte's name. Indris, as an Essail, you will guide the earth essence from Sal'thorin and help it resonate with this land.
say:8:1422690007:0.source_cn: 埃隆，你作为林中子民，代表弥萨忒呼唤此地地脉。因度厄则...

say:10:1422690008:0.text: Merlin—you'll weave the Sylvan Tendril, combining the power of both the Dark Forest and Sal'thorin. Bind the two together.
say:10:1422690008:0.source_cn: 而梅林，你将通过魔力借助蕴含薄暮丛林和萨洛克兰双重力量...
say:10:1422690008:0.male: Merlin—you'll weave the Sylvan Tendril, combining the power of both the Dark Forest and Sal'thorin. Bind the two together.
say:10:1422690008:0.female: Merlin—you'll weave the Sylvan Tendril, combining the power of both the Dark Forest and Sal'thorin. Bind the two together.
