choice_prompt:11:1422690008.source_cn: 而梅林，你将通过魔力借助蕴含薄暮丛林和萨洛克兰双重力量的织叶，将彼此连结——
choice_prompt:11:1422690008.male: Merlin—you'll weave the Sylvan Tendril, combining the power of both the Dark Forest and Sal'thorin. Bind the two together.
choice_prompt:11:1422690008.female: Merlin—you'll weave the Sylvan Tendril, combining the power of both the Dark Forest and Sal'thorin. Bind the two together.

say:12:1422690009:0.text: Indris... Your homeland and your ancestors' land have remained apart for over a millennium.
say:12:1422690009:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你的故乡与先祖的家园，已然分离了千年之久。

say:13:1422690010:0.text: Let this division end, here and now. Let the lands be one again.
say:13:1422690010:0.source_cn: 就从现在开始，让这两片土地再度交融吧。

say:0:1422690201:0.text: Misarte has sent new guidance. Follow its lead.
say:0:1422690201:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒有了新指引，跟着使者走吧。

say:0:1422690301:0.text: It isn't turning me away this time.

say:1:1422690401:1.text: The trial has ended. Misarte is lifting her punishment. And now... I will act as her hand.
say:1:1422690401:1.source_cn: 考验已然结束，弥萨忒将收回祂的惩戒，而我，将作为祂的代行。

say:2:1422690402:1.text: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.
say:2:1422690402:1.source_cn: ……但，梅林，我不知道该怎样收回这份剥离的惩戒。
say:2:1422690402:1.male: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.
say:2:1422690402:1.female: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.

choice_prompt:3:1422690402.text: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.
choice_prompt:3:1422690402.source_cn: ……但，梅林，我不知道该怎样收回这份剥离的惩戒。
choice_prompt:3:1422690402.male: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.
choice_prompt:3:1422690402.female: ... But Merlin, I still don't know how to undo what was cast upon us.

say:4:1422690403:1.text: Reintegration...? Ah, you mean returning the Sylvan Tendril that was severed from the Sylvan Egg?
say:4:1422690403:1.source_cn: 融合……啊，你是说！你是指将从翡绿之卵上分离的织叶归还原位？
say:4:1422690403:1.male: Reintegration...? Ah, you mean returning the Sylvan Tendril that was severed from the Sylvan Egg?
say:4:1422690403:1.female: Reintegration...? Ah, you mean returning the Sylvan Tendril that was severed from the Sylvan Egg?

say:5:1422690405:1.text: Once the Sylvan Egg is whole again, the foundation of the separation curse will be undone.
say:5:1422690405:1.source_cn: 不错，若翡绿之卵恢复完整，从分离状态重归一体，那么剥离...

say:6:1422690406:1.text: Merlin, with your magic, the Sylvan Tendril has already cleansed Feli and me of the curse.
say:6:1422690406:1.source_cn: 织叶在梅林的魔力引导下，就已经能够解除我与斐利尔的诅咒。
say:6:1422690406:1.male: Merlin, with your magic, the Sylvan Tendril has already cleansed Feli and me of the curse.
say:6:1422690406:1.female: Merlin, with your magic, the Sylvan Tendril has already cleansed Feli and me of the curse.

say:7:1422690407:1.text: So with Misarte's blessing and the sacred light of the Lucent Tree... a restored Sylvan Egg may even—
say:7:1422690407:1.source_cn: 那么，在弥萨忒的代行许可下，借助流荧树的神力，完整的翡...

choice_prompt:8:1422690407.text: So with Misarte's blessing and the sacred light of the Lucent Tree... a restored Sylvan Egg may even—
choice_prompt:8:1422690407.source_cn: 那么，在弥萨忒的代行许可下，借助流荧树的神力，完整的翡绿之卵或许能——

say:9:1422690408:1.text: That's wonderful news. Finally, a glimmer of hope!
say:9:1422690408:1.source_cn: 太好了……终于，终于有希望了！

say:10:1422690409:1.text: There's just one thing I can't wrap my head around. If this punishment stemmed from separation, why did Misarte entrust the corrupted part to someone in exile?
say:10:1422690409:1.source_cn: 我仍有一丝疑惑。若是剥离的惩戒，弥萨忒为何要将那被污染...

say:12:1422690410:1.text: Even if it was tainted... it was still once part of the Sylvan Egg. It held divine power, didn't it?
say:12:1422690410:1.source_cn: 纵然被污染，被抛弃，那也同样是翡绿之卵的一部分，曾被弥...

say:13:1422690411:1.text: Perhaps... Misarte had a greater purpose we do not yet see.
say:13:1422690411:1.source_cn: 或许，弥萨忒有更特殊的用意。

say:14:1422690412:1.text: For now, let's focus on reintegration.
say:14:1422690412:1.source_cn: 眼下，还是先来尝试能不能融合吧。

say:15:1422690413:1.text: If it works, then we'll journey to Sal'thorin next. And if it doesn't—
say:15:1422690413:1.source_cn: 如果能成功，萨洛克兰之行也就迫在眉睫了。如果失败——

say:16:1422690414:1.text: No. We won't fail. It's time. Let's begin.
say:16:1422690414:1.source_cn: 不，应当不会失败。时机已至，我们开始吧。

say:18:1422690404:1.text: I see. If we return the lost Sylvan Tendril and reunite it with the Sylvan Egg...
say:18:1422690404:1.source_cn: 我明白了，将最初被剥离的织叶与翡绿之卵重新合一……

say:0:1422690601:0.text: Look! It's showing us the way—come on!
say:0:1422690601:0.source_cn: 是鹿灵！祂应该是想指引我们方向，我们走！

say:0:1422690701:0.text: Incredible... I'm walking behind the avatar of a goddess...
say:0:1422690701:0.source_cn: 不可思议，我居然在跟着神的化身前进……

say:0:1422691001:0.text: Inside the Ivory Tree... there's another hidden space?
say:0:1422691001:0.source_cn: 皎月树内，竟然还有另一重空间。

say:1:1422691002:0.text: I've never heard of anything like this, not even in ancient records.
say:1:1422691002:0.source_cn: 我也是第一次知道，皎月树还有这样的秘密。

say:2:1422691102:1.text: How could something so vile exist within the Ivory Tree, which was once blessed by Misarte?
say:2:1422691102:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒赐福过的皎月树内，怎么会孕育着如此邪恶的存在？

say:3:1422691103:1.text: And look at the walls... they're discolored. It's corroding the entire space.
say:3:1422691103:1.source_cn: ……不止如此，看那些变色的内壁，它甚至在侵蚀着这个空间。

say:4:1422691104:1.text: The Deer Spirit brought us here for a reason. We must uncover it.
say:4:1422691104:1.source_cn: 鹿灵带着我们来此，自有其用意。

say:2:1422691402:1.text: You are ripe... ripe and full.

say:3:1422691403:1.text: I, Saida, must feast... I must grow...

say:4:1422691404:0.text: No more cages, I must spread...

say:6:1422691405:0.text: Vile Hypogean! So you were the one who tainted the Sylvan Egg!
say:6:1422691405:0.source_cn: 恶魔悉达！所以是你玷污了翡绿之卵！

say:7:1422691406:1.text: It throbbed with promise... it sang to me... It was so rich. I took what I needed...

say:8:1422691407:0.text: So it was you. The one who forced my people into exile.
say:8:1422691407:0.source_cn: 这就是当年导致我族被驱逐的罪魁祸首？

choice_prompt:9:1422691407.text: So it was you. The one who forced my people into exile.
choice_prompt:9:1422691407.source_cn: 这就是当年导致我族被驱逐的罪魁祸首？

say:10:1422691408:0.text: She's within the Ivory Tree. If she breaks free, every living thing in the Vaduso Mountains could be wiped out!
say:10:1422691408:0.source_cn: 她竟然身处在皎月树内部，一旦破出，瓦度索山脉的所有生灵...

say:11:1422691409:1.text: In Misarte's name, I will end this!
say:11:1422691409:1.source_cn: ……以弥萨忒之名，我要终结你的威胁！

say:1:1422691701:1.text: Her aura—why did it suddenly spike?!
say:1:1422691701:1.source_cn: 她的气息怎么会突然变强了！

choice_prompt:2:1422691701.text: Her aura—why did it suddenly spike?!
choice_prompt:2:1422691701.source_cn: 她的气息怎么会突然变强了！

say:3:1422691702:1.text: This is bad. We brought the Sylvan Egg into this space, and she's touched it again!
say:3:1422691702:1.source_cn: 糟了，我们带着翡绿之卵进入了这个空间，这个恶魔又接触到...

say:4:1422691703:1.text: And not just that. Look at those seeds on the ground. She's using them to regenerate!
say:4:1422691703:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，看那些地面上的种子。她借着这些分散的种子在不...

say:5:1422691704:0.text: That's what makes her so dangerous...

say:7:1422691705:1.source_cn: 悉达、将、永远、存在、只要、养分……

say:8:1422691706:1.text: Not while there's a root to cling to... sap to drink... flesh to hollow out.
say:8:1422691706:1.source_cn: 根系、营养、悉达、再次、壮大……

say:10:1422691708:0.text: I sink into roots... I twist into trees.
say:10:1422691708:0.source_cn: 悉达、有根、有种子、变成丛林、吃掉丛林……

say:11:1422691709:0.text:
I hollow the forest...
And now, I breathe through everything.
say:11:1422691709:0.source_cn: 悉达、会成为丛林……\n悉达、就是丛林……

say:14:1422691711:1.text: Calm down, Eironn! She's still talking, which means we can still get information out of her.
say:14:1422691711:1.source_cn: 埃隆，冷静！既然她在回答，我们得问出更多情报。

say:15:1422691712:0.text: We need to figure out how to beat her.
say:15:1422691712:0.source_cn: 我们得找到对付她的办法！

choice_prompt:16:1422691712.text: We need to figure out how to beat her.
choice_prompt:16:1422691712.source_cn: 我们得想办法找到对付她的办法！

say:18:1422691713:1.text: I found the fruit... warm, throbbing.

say:19:1422691714:1.text: They discovered me... Dura tried to cage me, but I slithered free.
say:19:1422691714:1.source_cn: 悉达、被发现、艾雅、封印、逃离……

say:20:1422691715:1.text: My roots sank deep, even as the fruit withered...
say:20:1422691715:1.source_cn: 但悉达、扎下了根、可是、果实只剩……

say:21:1422691716:0.text: Tendrils spreading through dark places... safe, waiting...
say:21:1422691716:0.source_cn: 悉达的根、越走越远、悉达、地下、安全了……

say:22:1422691717:1.text: Then came the fire... it burned... but not all of me. My deepest roots remained hungry, patient.
say:22:1422691717:1.source_cn: 后来、有火、悉达、怕、但还有、根系……

say:23:1422691718:0.text: You're here. So sweet and tender, you will feed me now... How generous you are.
say:23:1422691718:0.source_cn: 你们、会是养分、悉达、很开心……

say:24:1422691719:0.text: Come closer, let me taste... Through you, I'll live forever.

choice_prompt:25:1422691719.text: Come closer, let me taste... Through you, I'll live forever.

say:27:1422691720:1.source_cn: 火焰或许是她的克星！试试吧！

say:28:1422691721:1.text: We'll burn her seeds to stop her from regenerating.
say:28:1422691721:1.source_cn: 我们焚毁她所有的种子，切断她的重生之路。

say:29:1422691722:1.text: And sever her roots—cut off the source before she regrows.
say:29:1422691722:1.source_cn: 还要破坏她的根系，阻断她汲取力量的渠道。

say:30:1422691723:1.text: I'll use the Eclipsion. My bow is said to never miss and will chase enemies across the land.
say:30:1422691723:1.source_cn: 让我来试试吧，万里逐敌，开弓必中的杜恩加尔——

say:31:1422691724:1.text: Powered by the fiery essence of Helthor and dragonflame, it's made for hunting down evil, like her!
say:31:1422691724:1.source_cn: 它凝聚了赫托与龙的火焰精粹，正适合焚烧这些。

say:32:1422691725:1.text: Let's strike her down with everything we've got!

choice:25:0:1.text: She must be afraid of fire!
choice:25:0:1.male: She must be afraid of fire!
choice:25:0:1.female: She must be afraid of fire!

choice:16:0:1.text: Saida, how did you get here?
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 那么悉达，你为什么会在这里？
choice:16:0:1.male: Saida, how did you get here?
choice:16:0:1.female: Saida, how did you get here?

say:1:1422692001:1.text: Did it work? She's not regenerating...

choice_prompt:2:1422692001.text: Did it work? She's not regenerating...

say:4:1422692002:1.text: The Ivory Tree... the Deer Spirit... I can feel them. They're overjoyed...
say:4:1422692002:1.source_cn: 嗯，我能感到皎月树的气息，还有鹿灵，那样喜悦……

say:5:1422692004:1.text: It's granted me memories... from Misarte herself.
say:5:1422692004:1.source_cn: 鹿灵……已经将所有的过去传达给我了。

say:6:1422692005:1.text: Back then... the Hypogean had already infected the Sylvan Egg. Purification was impossible.
say:6:1422692005:1.source_cn: 当年……弥萨忒面临着两难抉择——恶魔已经寄生于翡绿之卵...

say:7:1422692006:1.text: To cut away the corruption, she had to tear out a piece of her own divine power.
say:7:1422692006:1.source_cn: 而一旦剥离被污染的部分，也意味着要分离祂的神力。

say:8:1422692007:1.text: So she created this hidden space, sealing Saida's core body here, and hoped the Ivory Tree's power could slowly purify it.
say:8:1422692007:1.source_cn: 于是，弥萨忒创造了这一空间，将恶魔悉达的本体镇压于此，...

say:9:1422692008:1.text: The rest of the corrupted fragment... it traveled with the Sylvan Tendril to Sal'thorin, alongside my ancestors.
say:9:1422692008:1.source_cn: 而另一部分……则随着织叶和我的先祖们前往了萨洛克兰。

say:10:1422692009:1.text: No wonder Misarte was so furious... This Hypogean has been a threat for two thousand years.
say:10:1422692009:1.source_cn: 这样棘手的恶魔，难怪弥萨忒如此震怒……

say:11:1422692010:1.text: Misarte likely believed that dividing and sealing her in two halves would weaken her enough to keep her contained.
say:11:1422692010:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒可能认为，将恶魔分割成两部分，分别镇压，会使其力...

say:13:1422692011:1.text: But she underestimated the nature of a parasite, never anticipated... that even split, Saida could slowly regain strength in both places.
say:13:1422692011:1.source_cn: 但祂没料到这恶魔即使分裂，也能在两地缓慢恢复力量。

say:14:1422692012:1.text: Misarte had no other choice. If the Hypogean fully merged with the Sylvan Egg, the whole of Vaduso would've been destroyed.
say:14:1422692012:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒当时别无选择。如果恶魔彻底融入翡绿之卵，整个瓦度...

say:15:1422692013:1.text: Separation was the only way forward. But the price was immense.
say:15:1422692013:1.source_cn: 分离是唯一的选择，尽管代价沉重。

say:16:1422692014:0.text: There was one thing Misarte overlooked—a parasite can silently influence the host's will. Whispers here, seeds there... until the host doesn't even know they're compromised.
say:16:1422692014:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒还忽略了一件事——寄生者能够悄无声息地影响宿主的意志。

say:17:1422692015:0.text: Saida's influence and the cursed punishment slowly poisoned the minds of the Essail.
say:17:1422692015:0.source_cn: 恶魔悉达的暗示，以及诅咒的惩罚，让艾塞勒们迷失了心智。

say:18:1422692016:0.text: Is that why Seralyth became so obsessed? Saida was even able to hide a part of her within the Eclipsion...
say:18:1422692016:0.source_cn: 所以……奈萨雷斯才会如此偏执吗？后来，她的一部分又躲入...

choice_prompt:19:1422692016.text: Is that why Seralyth became so obsessed? Saida was even able to hide a part of her within the Eclipsion...
choice_prompt:19:1422692016.source_cn: 所以……奈萨雷斯才会如此偏执吗？后来，她的一部分又躲入了杜恩加尔……

say:20:1422692017:0.text: The Hypogean preyed on all their despair. Turned their grief into a path for her own return, luring them into even darker paths...
say:20:1422692017:0.source_cn: 正是。恶魔利用艾塞勒们对诅咒的绝望，引导他们走向了更加...

say:21:1422692018:1.text: So... they weren't punished for defying the goddess or joining the war... but because they unknowingly brought a Hypogean back to the Dark Forest, and gave her the perfect host...
say:21:1422692018:1.source_cn: 原来，违背神意参战并非根本原因……而是因为他们无意中将...

say:22:1422692019:0.text: Misarte's judgment was meant to protect all other life. But a two-thousand-year curse... it's still a cruel fate.
say:22:1422692019:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒的惩戒是在保护其他生灵。但两千年的诅咒——还是过...

say:23:1422692020:1.text: I believe Misarte's true intention was never to punish you forever. She was waiting... waiting until Saida could be utterly destroyed.
say:23:1422692020:1.source_cn: 我想，弥萨忒的真意并非永远惩罚你们，祂只是在等待恶魔悉...

say:24:1422692021:1.text: Then... this was our true trial. Our redemption.
say:24:1422692021:1.source_cn: 所以，击败恶魔悉达才是我们真正的使命和救赎之路？

say:25:1422692022:0.text: Yes. Now you may tell your people that the Essail curse can finally be lifted.
say:25:1422692022:0.source_cn: 是的。现在，你可以告诉你的族人，艾塞勒的诅咒已经可以被...

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 或许绝望才是恶魔悉达的养分……

say:27:1422692003:1.text: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.
say:27:1422692003:1.source_cn: 不愧是梅林，封印得如此彻底，我能感应到，鹿灵认为此处已...
say:27:1422692003:1.male: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.
say:27:1422692003:1.female: As expected of Merlin. Such a perfect seal. I can sense it... The Deer Spirit believes this place has been sanctified again.

say:0:1422692101:0.text: Two thousand years of suffering... nearing its end at last.
say:0:1422692101:0.source_cn: 两千年的诅咒……要结束了……

say:1:1422692102:0.text: Let's go. The Deer Spirit has given me permission to perform the lifting of the curse on its behalf.
say:1:1422692102:0.source_cn: 出发吧，鹿灵准许我代行解除诅咒了。

say:0:1422692201:0.text: You're finally back! Any later and I would've had to go drag you back myself.
say:0:1422692201:0.source_cn: 可算是回来了！再不回来，我就得去找你们了。

say:1:1422692301:0.text: To put it simply, the Divine Dew has started overflowing for no reason.
say:1:1422692301:0.source_cn: 简单来说，珍贵的恩典灵露不知道为什么突然开始泛滥了。

say:2:1422692302:0.text: And with it everywhere, folks are letting their guard down. Some have gone up to the surface and gotten corrupted. Others are talking about "restoring the old ways".
say:2:1422692302:0.source_cn: 有灵露在，民众便不再将诅咒视作威胁。有些人冲动之下去往...

say:3:1422692303:0.text: Oh! Who might this handsome guest be?
say:3:1422692303:0.source_cn: 啊，说起来，这位如此气度不凡的——

say:4:1422692304:0.text: Ravion, mind your manners in front of our visitors!
say:4:1422692304:0.source_cn: ……不要当着客人说这种失礼的话！

say:5:1422692305:0.text: Ahem. This is Eironn of the Dark Forest. And this is Ravion of Sal'thorin.
say:5:1422692305:0.source_cn: 咳咳，这位是来自薄暮丛林的埃隆，这是萨洛克兰的沙利叶。

choice_prompt:6:1422692305.text: Ahem. This is Eironn of the Dark Forest. And this is Ravion of Sal'thorin.
choice_prompt:6:1422692305.source_cn: 咳咳，这位是来自薄暮丛林的埃隆，这是萨洛克兰的沙利叶。

say:7:1422692306:1.text: A pleasure, Lord Ravion... I've heard much about you on the way here.
say:7:1422692306:1.source_cn: 沙利叶阁下，我是埃隆。你的大名在途中我已经多有耳闻。

say:8:1422692307:0.text: Then you've heard of my charm, my wisdom, and my so-called princely title—
say:8:1422692307:0.source_cn: 完蛋，想必无论是我的美德还是我的风评还是我的王子头衔都...

say:9:1422692308:0.text: All things that no longer exist.
say:9:1422692308:0.source_cn: 都是些早就不存在的东西。

say:10:1422692309:0.text: And we mustn't forget my mother.

say:11:1422692310:0.text: Enough! To the matter at hand.

say:13:1422692314:0.text: Sounds like you've had quite the time together.
say:13:1422692314:0.source_cn: 好吧，看来你们在薄暮丛林一起经历了许多。

say:15:1422692316:0.text: Right, right. The curse is no longer the only issue here.
say:15:1422692316:0.source_cn: 好吧好吧。正事就是现在诅咒已经不是最紧要的问题。

say:16:1422692317:0.text: Our Divine Dew reserves will sustain us temporarily.
say:16:1422692317:0.source_cn: 反正我们还有灵露库存，至少能维持一段时间。

say:17:1422692318:0.text: But we're close to lifting the—

say:18:1422692319:0.text: Lifting the curse is merely the beginning, Indris. The true challenge is breaking the chains around people's hearts.
say:18:1422692319:0.source_cn: 解除诅咒只是第一步，因度厄。真正的挑战在于解开人心的束缚。

say:19:1422692320:0.text: The Essail have been bound to the underground and the curse for two thousand years. Their fear and sense of tradition run deep.
say:19:1422692320:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒们已经被地底的生活和诅咒束缚了两千年，思想、习惯...

say:20:1422692321:0.text: Even if the curse lifts tomorrow, do you really think everyone will be ready for a new way of life?
say:20:1422692321:0.source_cn: 即使明天诅咒消失，你认为所有人都能立即适应新的生活吗？

say:21:1422692322:0.text: Sunlight burns when all you've ever known is shadow. Freedom feels like chaos to those used to chains.
say:21:1422692322:0.source_cn: 阳光会灼伤习惯了黑暗的眼睛，自由会迷惑习惯了限制的心灵。

say:22:1422692323:0.text: Lord Ravion is right. Curses of the flesh are easy enough. The ones of the soul... take longer to heal.
say:22:1422692323:0.source_cn: 沙利叶阁下说得有道理。解除身体的诅咒容易，解除心灵的禁...

say:23:1422692324:0.source_cn: 那现在我们应该做些什么？

say:24:1422692325:0.text: First, we deal with the overflowing Divine Dew. The Dew is limited, but now Sal'thorin is seeing an abnormal surplus.
say:24:1422692325:0.source_cn: 首先解决灵露泛滥的事情。灵露是有限的，但现在萨洛克兰出...

say:26:1422692326:0.text: And with all the talk of restoring the old ways, there's definitely someone scheming behind the scenes.
say:26:1422692326:0.source_cn: 加上那些恢复旧制的言论，这背后必然有人在谋划什么。

say:27:1422692327:1.text: I already have a suspect in mind. But before we act, we'll need proof.
say:27:1422692327:1.source_cn: 虽说我已经对幕后主使大概有了猜测，但得找到确凿证据才能定罪。

say:28:1422692328:0.text: So, who's up for a little mystery-solving?
say:28:1422692328:0.source_cn: 诸位，有兴趣参与这个简单的侦探游戏吗？

choice_prompt:29:1422692328.text: So, who's up for a little mystery-solving?
choice_prompt:29:1422692328.source_cn: 诸位，有兴趣参与这个简单的侦探游戏吗？

say:30:1422692329:2.text: I knew you would, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Always so dependable.
say:30:1422692329:2.male: I knew you would, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Always so dependable.
say:30:1422692329:2.female: I knew you would, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Always so dependable.

say:31:1422692330:1.text: With you on our side, our chances of success just went up.
say:31:1422692330:1.source_cn: 有你的加入，我们的胜算会大大增加。
say:31:1422692330:1.male: With you on our side, our chances of success just went up.
say:31:1422692330:1.female: With you on our side, our chances of success just went up.

say:32:1422692338:0.text: Let's get to the point. Where do we start?
say:32:1422692338:0.source_cn: 既然如此，我们该从何处着手？

say:33:1422692339:0.text: I've got some leads. We just need to investigate further.
say:33:1422692339:0.source_cn: 我这里已经掌握了一些线索，只需要进一步调查就好。

say:34:1422692340:1.text: Shelvy has some information, and some dark corners of Sal'thorin are hiding intel too.
say:34:1422692340:1.source_cn: 舍尔菲那里有些消息，萨洛克兰一些黑暗的角落也藏着情报。

say:37:1422692331:1.text: As Misarte's chosen, it's my duty to see this curse lifted.
say:37:1422692331:1.source_cn: 作为弥萨忒的代行者，我有责任确保艾塞勒一族的诅咒得以解除。

say:38:1422692332:1.text: If this investigation serves that end, I'll commit fully.
say:38:1422692332:1.source_cn: 如果这是解除诅咒前的必要条件，我自当鼎力相助。

say:39:1422692333:0.text: And... I do want to understand Sal'thorin better.
say:39:1422692333:0.source_cn: 况且，我也有意深入了解萨洛克兰的现状……

say:40:1422692334:0.text: *Gasp* <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd refuse me? My heart is shattered!
say:40:1422692334:0.male: *Gasp* <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd refuse me? My heart is shattered!
say:40:1422692334:0.female: *Gasp* <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd refuse me? My heart is shattered!

say:42:1422692336:0.text: Then for the sake of diplomacy—and this heartbreakingly handsome face—please help us!
say:42:1422692336:0.source_cn: 好吧，看在我这张美丽的脸的份上。帮帮我们吧！
say:42:1422692336:0.male: Then for the sake of diplomacy—and this heartbreakingly handsome face—please help us!
say:42:1422692336:0.female: Then for the sake of diplomacy—and this heartbreakingly handsome face—please help us!

say:43:1422692337:0.text: You'll grant me this wish, won't you?
say:43:1422692337:0.male: You'll grant me this wish, won't you?
say:43:1422692337:0.female: You'll grant me this wish, won't you?

choice:29:2:3.text: Do I even get to say no?
choice:29:2:3.male: Do I even get to say no?
choice:29:2:3.female: Do I even get to say no?

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 沙利叶是萨洛克兰的王子

say:44:1422692311:0.text: Merlin! Please, don't jest. I'm no prince.
say:44:1422692311:0.source_cn: 请别开玩笑了！梅林！我可不是什么王子……
say:44:1422692311:0.male: Merlin! Please, don't jest. I'm no prince.
say:44:1422692311:0.female: Merlin! Please, don't jest. I'm no prince.

say:45:1422692312:0.text: Scion of the Lucent Tree—is that not royalty in its own right?
say:45:1422692312:0.source_cn: 流荧树之子，在某种意义上不也是一种王子吗？

say:46:1422692313:0.source_cn: 因度厄！你怎么也开起了我的玩笑！

choice:6:1:2.text: Eironn is the Dark Forest's prince.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 埃隆是薄暮丛林的王子
choice:6:1:2.male: Eironn is the Dark Forest's prince.
choice:6:1:2.female: Eironn is the Dark Forest's prince.

say:1:1422692401:1.text: Not more clothing purchases, I assume?
say:1:1422692401:1.source_cn: 这次总不会是来买衣服的吧？各位大人。

say:2:1422692402:1.text: Ravion sent us. We need to know what you've found out about the Divine Dew.
say:2:1422692402:1.source_cn: 沙利叶让我们来问灵露之事。说说你知道的状况。

say:3:1422692403:1.text: I see. Recently, a large amount of Divine Dew beyond the usual supply has appeared in Sal'thorin.
say:3:1422692403:1.source_cn: 原来如此，最近这段时间萨洛克兰中出现了许多超出常规供应...

choice_prompt:4:1422692403.text: I see. Recently, a large amount of Divine Dew beyond the usual supply has appeared in Sal'thorin.
choice_prompt:4:1422692403.source_cn: 原来如此，最近这段时间萨洛克兰中出现了许多超出常规供应的恩典灵露。

say:5:1422692404:1.text: I've looked into it. The amount on the streets has spiked, but Ravion's controlled source checks out clean.
say:5:1422692404:1.source_cn: 根据我的调查，市面上的灵露总量确实增加了。但沙利叶控制...

say:7:1422692405:0.text: It's like this extra supply appeared out of thin air. Most of it's moving through back channels and black market trades. It's disrupting everything.
say:7:1422692405:0.source_cn: 这些额外的灵露如同凭空出现，在暗市流通，扰乱了原本稳定...

say:8:1422692406:1.text: I assume someone's using the Dew to manipulate public sentiment?
say:8:1422692406:1.source_cn: 有人利用灵露来操控民心？

say:9:1422692407:1.text: And fan rumors. People are saying "the Divine Dew is running out".
say:9:1422692407:1.source_cn: 还不时有人散布谣言，类似灵露即将断绝之类的。

say:10:1422692408:0.text: Can you trace where these black market supplies started?
say:10:1422692408:0.source_cn: 能查到灵露的初始供应者吗？

say:11:1422692409:0.text: I have a few leads. Former military officers... and certain high-ranking priestesses from the old regime.
say:11:1422692409:0.source_cn: 已经有眉目了，源头正是一些以前的武官，与一部分当年地位...

say:13:1422692411:1.text: You catch on quick, Captain Indris. Then I'll spare the rest of the details.
say:13:1422692411:1.source_cn: 看来，因度厄大人已经明白背后的险恶之处了。那我就不多说了。

say:0:1422692501:0.text: Every three days at dusk... We'll need to visit the Lunaris Altar.
say:0:1422692501:0.source_cn: 每三天的黄昏……到时得去银月祭庭走一趟了。

say:1:1422692801:1.text: You dare defy me? Divine Dew is meant for the nobility first!
say:1:1422692801:1.source_cn: 平民，你怎敢反抗？难道不知道恩典灵露应当优先供应给贵族吗？

say:2:1422692802:1.text: W-why?! My child needs it too—to keep the corruption at bay!
say:2:1422692802:1.source_cn: 凭、凭什么！我的孩子同样需要灵露抵抗孽化！

say:3:1422692803:1.text: And things are different now! Your title doesn't give you more right to live than the rest of us!
say:3:1422692803:1.source_cn: 何、何况，现在大家都一样！你的贵族身份，不值钱了！

say:4:1422692804:1.text: Fool! Only noble lineage can properly channel the Dew's power!
say:4:1422692804:1.source_cn: 愚蠢！只有高贵血脉才能正确使用灵露的力量！

say:6:1422692805:1.text: Ridiculous! The Divine Dew is meant to counter the curse. Every Essail has the right to receive it.
say:6:1422692805:1.source_cn: 荒谬！灵露是为了抵御诅咒的影响，所有艾塞勒人都有资格获取。

say:7:1422692806:1.text: C-Captain Indris? What brings you here...?
say:7:1422692806:1.source_cn: 因、因度厄大人？您怎么会在这里……？

say:8:1422692807:1.text: I'm looking into irregularities in the Divine Dew distribution. Care to explain what I just heard?
say:8:1422692807:1.source_cn: 我正在调查灵露异常流通的情况。看来你对此很有见解？

say:9:1422692808:1.text: I-I was merely teaching this commoner the proper etiquette...
say:9:1422692808:1.source_cn: 我……我只是在教导这些平民应有的礼节……

say:10:1422692809:1.text: That's not true! He tried to take the Dew I bought while shouting about bloodlines!
say:10:1422692809:1.source_cn: 大人！他要抢走我买到的灵露！说这是“传统”！

narration:14:1422692811:0.text: The noble flees, leaving behind the uneasy commoner shuffling nervously.
narration:14:1422692811:0.source_cn: 抢夺灵露的贵族飞快地溜走了，只剩不安的平民，似乎要想要...

say:15:1422692812:1.text: Thank you, Captain Indris! I'll just—
say:15:1422692812:1.source_cn: 谢谢因度厄大人！我也先——

say:16:1422692813:1.text: Wait. What's this about buying Divine Dew? It should be distributed, not sold.
say:16:1422692813:1.source_cn: 别走，买来的灵露是怎么回事？现在不是正常配给吗？

say:17:1422692814:1.text: I... heard it's running out. That soon, only the nobles will have access.
say:17:1422692814:1.source_cn: 大人……我听说灵露快、快没了！只能从暗市买了点……

say:18:1422692815:1.text: So I... I bought some on the black market, just in case...
say:18:1422692815:1.source_cn: 他们说……之后只有贵族才能获得供应……我……

say:22:1422692818:1.text: Don't be. We're not here to punish you. We're here to stop whoever's behind this.
say:22:1422692818:1.source_cn: 不必害怕，我们就是来解决此事的。

say:23:1422692819:0.text: ... Alright. It's the priestesses at the Lunaris Altar. They claim the curse isn't real!
say:23:1422692819:0.source_cn: 好吧……是银月祭庭的祭司们……她们说诅咒是假的！

choice_prompt:24:1422692819.text: ... Alright. It's the priestesses at the Lunaris Altar. They claim the curse isn't real!
choice_prompt:24:1422692819.source_cn: 好吧……是银月祭庭的祭司们……她们说诅咒是假的！

say:26:1422692820:1.text: I-I'm just repeating what I heard. They say the curse, the dragon—none of it ever existed.
say:26:1422692820:1.source_cn: 我、我就是复述。她们说那些关于诅咒和龙的故事都是谎言。

say:27:1422692821:1.text: That when the Queen died, the Divine Dew began to disappear... and there was never enough for everyone.
say:27:1422692821:1.source_cn: 仁慈的女王陛下死后，灵露源头就在逐渐枯竭，根本不够所有...

say:28:1422692822:1.text: They also said that Lord Ravion claimed there was a "new world" waiting for us on the surface, just to cover up the truth.
say:28:1422692822:1.source_cn: 她们还说，沙利叶大人为了掩盖真相，才声称地表上有新世界...

say:29:1422692823:1.text: And the ones who believed him and went up... never came back. They say he's sending us to our deaths.
say:29:1422692823:1.source_cn: 而听信传言去地表的人，都孽化了。沙、沙利叶大人其实是在...

say:30:1422692824:1.text: The logic has holes, but... I admit it sounds plausible.
say:30:1422692824:1.source_cn: 有漏洞，但在我一个外人听来，这确实很像真的。

say:31:1422692825:1.text: So many people started doubting! I... I also...
say:31:1422692825:1.source_cn: 所以……很多人开始怀疑了！我、我也……

say:33:1422692826:1.text: Listen. I've returned from the surface. The curse is real, but we've also found a way to break it.
say:33:1422692826:1.source_cn: 听着，我刚从地表回来。诅咒确实存在，但我们也找到了解除...

say:34:1422692827:1.text: Soon, no Essail will need to rely on Divine Dew anymore!
say:34:1422692827:1.source_cn: 很快，所有艾塞勒人都不必再依赖灵露！

say:35:1422692828:1.source_cn: 真的吗？可德莱雅大人说——

choice_prompt:36:1422692828.source_cn: 真的吗？可德莱雅大人说——

say:37:1422692829:1.text: She's... the one I bought the Divine Dew from...
say:37:1422692829:1.source_cn: 就是、我就是从她那里买到了灵露……

say:39:1422692831:1.text: At the Lunaris Altar... there's a secret gathering every three days at dusk.
say:39:1422692831:1.source_cn: 银月祭庭……每三天的黄昏会有一次秘密集会。

say:40:1422692832:1.text: Understood. Thank you for your honesty. You've helped us a lot.
say:40:1422692832:1.source_cn: 我知道了，多谢你的信息。

say:41:1422692833:1.text: Captain Indris... what's the truth, really? I just want to protect my family. I don't want to become corrupted...
say:41:1422692833:1.source_cn: 大人——到底什么是真的？我只是不想孽化……

say:42:1422692834:1.text: Just wait. The truth will reveal itself.
say:42:1422692834:1.source_cn: 等着看吧，真相会大白的。

say:0:1422693001:0.text: So Thador still has this many loyal followers...
say:0:1422693001:0.source_cn: 都铎竟然还有这么多忠心手下……

say:0:1422693201:0.text: Stay sharp. He's likely stationed a strong force here.
say:0:1422693201:0.source_cn: 小心些，都铎应当派了重兵在此把守。

say:1:1422693401:0.text: Heh... all of you. Especially you, Indris...
say:1:1422693401:0.source_cn: 呵……你……你们，尤其是你，因度厄……

say:2:1422693402:0.text: Will you destroy our people's future again? All because of some naive hope?
say:2:1422693402:0.source_cn: 你又要凭着自己天真的妄想，毁掉整个族群的未来了吗……

say:3:1422693403:0.text: No, Thador. The real threat to Sal'thorin is the unchecked distribution of the Divine Dew. That is what's breaking us.
say:3:1422693403:0.source_cn: 像你这样继续肆意散播灵露，才是真正毁掉萨洛克兰的行径！

say:4:1422693404:0.text: You're blind! You're the one breaking us apart!
say:4:1422693404:0.source_cn: 想毁掉这里的明明是你！

say:5:1422693405:0.text: You have no idea the burden we carry. You just happened to meet a lucky mage who fixed your problems.
say:5:1422693405:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你根本不知道我们背负着多么沉重的过去，只是遇到...
say:5:1422693405:0.male: You have no idea the burden we carry. You just happened to meet a lucky mage who fixed your problems.
say:5:1422693405:0.female: You have no idea the burden we carry. You just happened to meet a lucky mage who fixed your problems.

say:6:1422693406:0.text: And now look at you. You parade around like some savior, spouting pretty lies about the surface while people suffer!
say:6:1422693406:0.source_cn: 于是你立刻摇身一变，装出一副高洁的英雄模样，说些不痛不...

say:7:1422693407:0.text: "Go above ground", you say—as if we haven't tried! The sunlight scorches, and the soil cuts like knives.
say:7:1422693407:0.source_cn: 你口口声声说要让我们上去，怎么上去？忍着灼烧一样的阳光...

say:8:1422693408:0.text: And look what happened days ago. The curse spiked, and the corruption spread! Everything worsened!
say:8:1422693408:0.source_cn: 所以，前些日子你不是也看到了吗？诅咒爆发，孽化加剧，让...

say:9:1422693409:0.text: Which is exactly why the usage of the Divine Dew must be stopped. It offers comfort but at the price of our minds and bodies. It's poison dressed as mercy.
say:9:1422693409:0.source_cn: 正因如此，才不能让灵露继续泛滥下去，那只是饮鸩止渴！

say:10:1422693410:0.text: There you go again, with your fine speeches. You'd tell a dying man, "Don't drink the water you've known all your life—it's poisoned."
say:10:1422693410:0.source_cn: 又来了，我们平民英雄的漂亮话。你对着无数马上要渴死的人...

say:11:1422693411:1.text: You tell us to go to the surface. It'll be fine. Just endure it.
say:11:1422693411:1.source_cn: 我们可以去地表，可以去晒太阳，只要忍忍——

say:13:1422693412:1.text: You promise them sunlight and salvation but give them nothing but pain and uncertainty.
say:13:1422693412:1.source_cn: 你给出了一个虚无缥缈的幻象，然后让更多人陷入疯狂……

say:14:1422693413:1.text: So why not the Divine Dew?!
say:14:1422693413:1.source_cn: 那么，灵露又有何不可呢？！

say:15:1422693414:1.text: At least the Divine Dew grants relief, if only for a little while.
say:15:1422693414:1.source_cn: 比起你那只存在于幻梦中的情景，灵露至少实实在在地给予了...

say:16:1422693415:1.text: Relief that twists and mutates your body, driving your mind into madness—
say:16:1422693415:1.source_cn: 但那最终会引导向孽化的结局。扭曲，变异，肉体腐败，彻底...

say:17:1422693416:1.text: Yet still, it quenches thirst, eases pain, and grants a moment of peace.
say:17:1422693416:1.source_cn: 但仍然，能够止渴，能够镇痛，能够给予片刻的安宁。

say:18:1422693417:1.text: A moment of peace is better than a lifetime of chasing illusions.
say:18:1422693417:1.source_cn: 哪怕是片刻真实的安宁，不也好过恒久的假象？

say:20:1422693418:1.text: Your self-righteous dreams are what tore apart the home we clung to! Wake up, Indris!
say:20:1422693418:1.source_cn: 因度厄，明明就是你那自以为是的一厢情愿，毁掉了我们习以...

say:22:1422693420:1.text: I know I may not grasp the full weight of your grief, General. But even so...
say:22:1422693420:1.source_cn: 你所背负的痛苦，我或许无法亲身体会，但现在——

say:23:1422693421:1.text: Isn't the most important thing to lift the punishment and curse you've all been burdened with?
say:23:1422693421:1.source_cn: 最重要的，难道不是先解除惩戒——也就是你们说的诅咒吗？

say:24:1422693422:0.text: Another youth with a smart mouth.
say:24:1422693422:0.source_cn: 哈，又来了一个说漂亮话的年轻人。

say:25:1422693423:0.text: The dream you speak of is built upon the illusory vision of <style="highlight">breaking the curse</style>.
say:25:1422693423:0.source_cn: 你们所谓的秩序，都建立在<style=highligh...

say:26:1422693424:0.text: You've destroyed the very foundation on which we survive, all to establish your self-congratulatory new fantasy.
say:26:1422693424:0.source_cn: 你们为此毁掉了我们赖以生存的根基，想建立起你们这个夸夸...

say:27:1422693425:0.text: And now? There's nothing left but chaos. Madness, creeping in from all sides.
say:27:1422693425:0.source_cn: 于是只有混乱，混乱，越来越癫狂的混乱。

choice_prompt:28:1422693425.text: And now? There's nothing left but chaos. Madness, creeping in from all sides.
choice_prompt:28:1422693425.source_cn: 于是只有混乱，混乱，越来越癫狂的混乱。

say:29:1422693426:0.text: With the dragon gone, the Divine Dew is disappearing. It can't last. And when it finally runs dry, what then? Will Sal'thorin, still dependent on it, be left to crumble in agony?
say:29:1422693426:0.source_cn: 一旦你无法再提供灵露，那么继续依赖灵露的萨洛克兰不是仍...

say:31:1422693428:0.text: You're willing to let everyone die just to preserve what once was.
say:31:1422693428:0.source_cn: 你只是想要让所有人，为你所忠诚的旧秩序殉葬……

say:34:1422693431:0.text: Wait... You're not an Essail... Who are you?
say:34:1422693431:0.source_cn: 不，你不是艾塞勒！你是谁！

say:35:1422693432:1.text: My name is Eironn. It might sound arrogant for me to introduce myself this way, but I think you'll want to know.
say:35:1422693432:1.source_cn: 我叫埃隆。自己这样自我介绍或许有些傲慢了，但我想，你应...

say:36:1422693433:1.text: I'm from the Dark Forest. Since birth, I've been called the <style="highlight">Scion of the Lucent Tree</style>.
say:36:1422693433:1.source_cn: 我来自薄暮丛林，自诞生以来，被族人冠以<style=h...

say:37:1422693434:1.text: As Misarte's proxy, I've witnessed Indris' journey of atonement on behalf of your people.
say:37:1422693434:1.source_cn: 我作为弥萨忒的代行，见证了因度厄代表你们族群的赎罪之旅。

say:38:1422693435:1.text: And I've come, as her envoy, to end this misguided punishment.
say:38:1422693435:1.source_cn: 而弥萨忒的意志也已然明确——我来到此处，将代表祂，终结...

say:40:1422693437:1.text: The Three Sages... the Lucent Tree... the Deer Spirit... Misarte.

say:43:1422693440:0.text: Then... the curse will be lifted?
say:43:1422693440:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒……所以，诅咒要终结了？

say:44:1422693441:0.text: Misarte and Merlin have both seen to it. The end of the curse is near.
say:44:1422693441:0.source_cn: 弥萨忒与梅林都在见证，这多年以来的苦痛，必将就此结束。
say:44:1422693441:0.male: Misarte and Merlin have both seen to it. The end of the curse is near.
say:44:1422693441:0.female: Misarte and Merlin have both seen to it. The end of the curse is near.

say:45:1422693442:0.text: And if you still have doubts, then come and feel it for yourself.
say:45:1422693442:0.source_cn: 如果你还心存疑虑的话，就一起来感受吧。

narration:46:1422693443:0.text: Thador's strength drains in an instant, his once-proud frame bowing under the weight of defeat.
narration:46:1422693443:0.source_cn: 都铎就像是被抽去了一直支撑着他的脊骨一般，颓然地弯下了腰。

narration:48:1422693444:0.text: For a moment, his guards hesitate—then, at a quiet nod from Indris, they move in to steady him as he sways.
narration:48:1422693444:0.source_cn: 他身后的卫兵们犹豫了片刻，在因度厄的示意下，搀住了摇摇...

say:51:1422693446:0.text: We'll end the mistakes of the past as quickly as we can, then...
say:51:1422693446:0.source_cn: 尽快去结束过去的错误，然后……

say:52:1422693447:0.text: Let's move. We've waited long enough.
say:52:1422693447:0.source_cn: 走吧，我已经迫不及待了。

choice_prompt:53:1422693447.text: Let's move. We've waited long enough.
choice_prompt:53:1422693447.source_cn: 走吧，我已经迫不及待了。

say:54:1422693448:1.text: Follow me. I can sense a place where the leyline energy is active... as if the roots of the Lucent Tree are calling me.
say:54:1422693448:1.source_cn: 跟我来吧，我感受到了一处地脉能量活跃的地方……就像流荧...

choice:53:0:1.text: Where do we go to lift the curse?
choice:53:0:1.male: Where do we go to lift the curse?
choice:53:0:1.female: Where do we go to lift the curse?

choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 龙离开了，灵露难以为继

say:1:1422693601:1.text: This used to be where Seralyth's statue stood. After her defeat, it shattered.
say:1:1422693601:1.source_cn: 这里曾是奈萨雷斯的雕像所在之处，她被打败后，雕像也随之粉碎。

say:2:1422693602:1.text: The statue was built over a convergence of leylines...
say:2:1422693602:1.source_cn: 这里亦是地脉节点，之前的雕像建立在地脉汇聚之处……

say:3:1422693603:1.text: Fitting. She was the one who led her people in their stand against the Hypogeans.
say:3:1422693603:1.source_cn: 毕竟是曾带领着绿裔对抗恶魔之人……

say:4:1422693604:1.source_cn: 不说了，就在这里施法吗？

say:5:1422693605:1.text: It should be done here, but—

say:6:1422693606:0.text: How should I describe it? It's like when we first used the earth essence—knowing the path ahead but unable to take the first step.
say:6:1422693606:0.source_cn: 该怎么形容呢，就像是之前土元素精华那样，明明知道前方有...

say:7:1422693607:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you offer me some guidance?
say:7:1422693607:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you offer me some guidance?
say:7:1422693607:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you offer me some guidance?

choice_prompt:8:1422693607.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you offer me some guidance?
choice_prompt:8:1422693607.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you offer me some guidance?

say:9:1422693608:0.text: So, with your guidance, we'll cast the spell and reconnect the two parts of the Sylvan Egg...
say:9:1422693608:0.source_cn: 也就是说，在你的引导和翡绿之卵的融合下，我们三人共同施法？
say:9:1422693608:0.male: So, with your guidance, we'll cast the spell and reconnect the two parts of the Sylvan Egg...
say:9:1422693608:0.female: So, with your guidance, we'll cast the spell and reconnect the two parts of the Sylvan Egg...

say:10:1422693610:1.text: This time, it's the exact opposite of our previous encounter with the elemental spirits. I represent the origins of the Dark Forest, and Indris represents the return of Sal'thorin.
say:10:1422693610:1.source_cn: 这一次与元素之灵的那次刚好相反，我代表着薄暮丛林的起源...

say:11:1422693611:1.text: Then, with the restored Sylvan Egg as the core, under Merlin's guidance, we will once again spread Misarte's forgiveness to her people.
say:11:1422693611:1.source_cn: 然后，以重新回归完整的翡绿之卵为核心，在梅林的引导下，...
say:11:1422693611:1.male: Then, with the restored Sylvan Egg as the core, under Merlin's guidance, we will once again spread Misarte's forgiveness to her people.
say:11:1422693611:1.female: Then, with the restored Sylvan Egg as the core, under Merlin's guidance, we will once again spread Misarte's forgiveness to her people.

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 像融入土元素精华那样吧

say:15:1422693609:0.text: Ah, I see. The restored Sylvan Egg is the perfect medium for spreading Misarte's power. Under your guidance, I'll join forces with Indris!
say:15:1422693609:0.source_cn: 对啊，完整的翡绿之卵是播撒弥萨忒力量，最好不过的介质，...
say:15:1422693609:0.male: Ah, I see. The restored Sylvan Egg is the perfect medium for spreading Misarte's power. Under your guidance, I'll join forces with Indris!
say:15:1422693609:0.female: Ah, I see. The restored Sylvan Egg is the perfect medium for spreading Misarte's power. Under your guidance, I'll join forces with Indris!

say:1:1422693701:1.text: I can feel it from this sapling! It shares the same origin as the Lucent Tree!
say:1:1422693701:1.source_cn: 这棵树苗，我感觉到了！这是与流荧树同根同源的力量！

say:2:1422693702:1.text: The earth's energy is flowing back, slowly returning to Misarte's embrace...
say:2:1422693702:1.source_cn: 在它的引导下，整个萨洛克兰的地脉都开始逐渐归于弥萨忒的...

say:3:1422693703:1.text: And the people—this land—the Lucent Tree loves them still. I can feel it.
say:3:1422693703:1.source_cn: 而此处的人们，我已经能感到这棵流荧树的亲昵与钟爱了。

choice_prompt:4:1422693703.text: And the people—this land—the Lucent Tree loves them still. I can feel it.
choice_prompt:4:1422693703.source_cn: 而此处的人们，我已经能感到这棵流荧树的亲昵与钟爱了。

say:5:1422693704:1.text: Yes. Misarte is using her gentle power to nourish this long-dried land. We succeeded.
say:5:1422693704:1.source_cn: 是的，弥萨忒正在用祂的温柔滋润这片干涸已久的土地，我们...

say:6:1422693706:1.text: Indris? You seem troubled. Is there something wrong?
say:6:1422693706:1.source_cn: 怎么了，因度厄？你表情很沉重，还有什么隐患吗？

say:7:1422693707:1.text: No... I'm relieved. Truly. But that relief helped me notice something I had overlooked.
say:7:1422693707:1.source_cn: 不，我非常高兴，如释重负。但也正因此，我察觉了之前在重...

say:8:1422693708:1.text: When I saw the out-of-place elemental spirits before, I had a similar feeling, but it wasn't until just now when the curse was lifted, that I confirmed it.
say:8:1422693708:1.source_cn: 在之前看到格格不入的元素之灵时，我就有了类似的感觉，但...

say:10:1422693710:1.text: Thador's accusations against me weren't unfounded.
say:10:1422693710:1.source_cn: 所以，都铎对我的指责，有一部分是正确的。

say:11:1422693711:1.text: I was born here—an Essail—carrying dreams too bright for a world weighed down by loss. Dreams of the surface, of sunlight and peace.
say:11:1422693711:1.source_cn: 我是在萨洛克兰出生的艾塞勒，对地表上的生活充满着自以为...

say:12:1422693712:1.text: And in chasing those dreams, I wounded the very hearts that had already endured too much.
say:12:1422693712:1.source_cn: 而这份幻想，也确实侮辱了他们的情感。

say:13:1422693713:1.text: Seralyth, Velara, Thador, Sage Tasso... So many names are now consigned to memory.
say:13:1422693713:1.source_cn: 奈萨雷斯，奎茵，都铎，已经去世的塔萨贤者，以及更多古老...

say:14:1422693714:1.text: Their grief, their bitterness, their fear, their anger...
say:14:1422693714:1.source_cn: 悲痛的，憎恨的，屈辱的，冤屈的，恐慌的。

say:15:1422693715:1.text: But also, an incredibly clear and deeply nostalgic... homesickness.
say:15:1422693715:1.source_cn: ……但却又无比确切，无比怀念的……思乡之情。

say:16:1422693716:1.text: The surface life I fantasized about was the true homeland they were forced to leave, having gone astray under false guidance, carrying immense pain.
say:16:1422693716:1.source_cn: 我所幻想的地表，是他们曾经在错误的引导下走上歧途，背负...

say:17:1422693717:1.text: Maybe that's why Misarte chose to plant a new Lucent Tree here.
say:17:1422693717:1.source_cn: 嗯，我想，这也是弥萨忒为什么赐予这里一棵新的流荧树的缘故吧。

say:18:1422693718:1.text: If it were just about ending the punishment, she could have simply lifted the curse.
say:18:1422693718:1.source_cn: 如果只是赐福于此，或者想要召唤萨洛克兰的人们回归，祂只...

say:19:1422693719:1.text: But she did more. She reconnected the leylines and blessed this place with new roots.
say:19:1422693719:1.source_cn: 但祂连结这里的地脉，用新的流荧树作为祂的祝福。

say:20:1422693720:1.text: There were mistakes... false paths... But now, it leads to something new.
say:20:1422693720:1.source_cn: 错误的引导，错误的路途，错误的终点，但……会再次迎来正...

choice_prompt:21:1422693720.text: There were mistakes... false paths... But now, it leads to something new.
choice_prompt:21:1422693720.source_cn: 错误的引导，错误的路途，错误的终点，但……会再次迎来正确的开始。

say:22:1422693721:1.text: Yes. Sal'thorin was born from pain—and though led astray by the Hypogean, it endured.
say:22:1422693721:1.source_cn: 我想，萨洛克兰的建立，尽管违背了弥萨忒的意愿，甚至是在...

say:23:1422693722:1.text: A kingdom carved from sorrow, but still a kingdom of its own.
say:23:1422693722:1.source_cn: 但，在漫长的苦痛与折磨中，坚韧不拔地建立起了属于自己的国度。

say:24:1422693723:1.text: Even with hearts full of sorrow and unrest, their struggle must have reached Misarte.
say:24:1422693723:1.source_cn: 即使心怀憎恨与不满，但这份坚持与努力，弥萨忒一定是有所...

say:25:1422693724:1.text: Even if we lost our way, time and time again...
say:25:1422693724:1.source_cn: 尽管我们……在之后漫长的道路上，再次走错了方向。

say:26:1422693725:1.text: Now, this tree—this gift—will bring us dawn once more, and with it, a true new beginning.
say:26:1422693725:1.source_cn: 但是，这棵树会再次为我们带来曙光，再次迎来一个——正确...

say:28:1422693705:1.text: I can feel it too. Misarte is welcoming the lost back home. Everything is connected once again.
say:28:1422693705:1.source_cn: 是的，我能感到，弥萨忒正在拥抱着离去的游子，这里的一切...

say:0:1422693801:0.text: Tending to plants is about forming a spiritual bond...
say:0:1422693801:0.source_cn: 养育植物，要用精神感应……

say:1:1422693802:0.text: I thought you only needed to add water and fertilizer?

say:2:1422693803:0.text: You two aren't even having the same conversation.

say:1:1422693902:0.text: Everything should be okay, I think...

narration:1:1422694001:0.text: You all return to Sal'thorin, still feeling like it all ended too fast...
narration:1:1422694001:0.source_cn: 你们怀揣着一切都已经结束的不真实感，返回了萨洛克兰……

narration:1:1422694101:0.text: Indris has his guards escort Delia to Lord Ravion. Right after, you all set off to find Thador...
narration:1:1422694101:0.source_cn: 因度厄叫来附近的卫兵们，将德莱雅遣送到沙利叶那里。随后...

say:2:1422695201:1.text: Brothers and sisters, behold the radiance of true Divine Dew! And now... compare it to the diluted mockery in your hands.
say:2:1422695201:1.source_cn: 兄弟姐妹们，看看这纯净的恩典灵露！再对比你们手中被稀释...

say:3:1422695202:1.text: You've all been deceived by Ravion! There's no curse! Dragons don't exist!
say:3:1422695202:1.source_cn: 你们被沙利叶欺骗了！根本没有什么诅咒！龙也并不存在！

say:4:1422695203:1.text: The truth is this: our supply of Divine Dew is dwindling, and Ravion—
say:4:1422695203:1.source_cn: 唯一的真相是灵露即将枯竭，沙利叶——

say:7:1422695205:1.source_cn: 因度厄！是沙利叶的走狗！抓住他们！

say:1:1422695401:0.text: No more lies. Tell us, where did you get all the Divine Dew from?
say:1:1422695401:0.source_cn: 谎言止步于此，德莱雅。灵露从何而来？

say:2:1422695402:0.text: Hmph! I have nothing to say to you.

say:3:1422695403:0.text: Do you think being stubborn will get you through this?
say:3:1422695403:0.source_cn: 你以为嘴硬可以扛过去吗？

say:4:1422695404:0.text: My faith is unshakable. I'd sooner die than betray it.
say:4:1422695404:0.source_cn: 我的信仰坚定，宁死也不会背叛。

say:5:1422695405:0.text: Die? Who spoke of killing? Ravion has a thousand ways to make you speak, but none will be quick or painless.
say:5:1422695405:0.source_cn: 死？谁说要你死了？沙利叶有一千种方法让你开口，却不会给...

say:6:1422695406:0.text: You're bluffing! He wouldn't... He's not like that!
say:6:1422695406:0.source_cn: 沙利叶……他才不会！你在虚张声势！

say:7:1422695407:0.text: Do you really want to test that belief? You forget who raised him.
say:7:1422695407:0.source_cn: 你真的想试试？别忘了他是谁的儿子！

say:8:1422695408:0.text: ... The Queen. Her Majesty... Fine. I'll speak.
say:8:1422695408:0.source_cn: 女王……女王陛下……够了，我说。

say:9:1422695409:0.text: It's Lord Thador. He's hiding in the <style="highlight">Burning Hollow</style>...
say:9:1422695409:0.source_cn: 是都铎大人……他在地底的<style=highligh...

choice_prompt:11:1422695409.text: It's Lord Thador. He's hiding in the <style="highlight">Burning Hollow</style>...
choice_prompt:11:1422695409.source_cn: 是都铎大人……他在地底的<style=highlight>烈焰岩窟</style>……

say:12:1422695410:0.text: He disappeared after the dragon left. It makes sense now. He's been biding his time in the shadows.
say:12:1422695410:0.source_cn: 龙飞走后，都铎就不见了。他应该一直藏在暗处。

say:13:1422695411:0.text: I'll have Delia taken away, and then we'll go straight to Thador.
say:13:1422695411:0.source_cn: 我叫人把德莱雅带走，然后我们直接去找都铎。

choice_prompt:14:1422695411.text: I'll have Delia taken away, and then we'll go straight to Thador.
choice_prompt:14:1422695411.source_cn: 我叫人把德莱雅带走，然后我们直接去找都铎。

say:15:1422695412:0.text: I learned from Ravion. Effective, it seems.
say:15:1422695412:0.source_cn: 我跟沙利叶学的，目前来看成效尚可。

say:16:1422695413:0.text: Ravion inherited Seralyth's cunning but wields it differently.
say:16:1422695413:0.source_cn: 沙利叶继承了奈萨雷斯的敏锐，却不像她那样直接展示力量。

say:17:1422695414:0.text: He disarms with charm before striking.
say:17:1422695414:0.source_cn: 他更喜欢用微笑和闲谈让对手放松警惕，然后一击必中。

say:19:1422695415:0.source_cn: 听起来沙利叶很有手段。

say:20:1422695416:0.text: Ravion's more complicated than anyone imagines. He was raised in his mother's shadow yet carved an opposite path...
say:20:1422695416:0.source_cn: 沙利叶比任何人想象的都要复杂。他在他母亲的阴影之下，却...

say:21:1422695417:0.text: But now's not the time to discuss Ravion. We need to meet with Thador.
say:21:1422695417:0.source_cn: 不过，现在不是讨论沙利叶的时候，我们得去会一会都铎了。

choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 学会用沙利叶和奈萨雷斯唬人了

say:0:1422695501:0.source_cn: 地底的烈焰岩窟……跟我来。

say:1:1422695602:0.text: I don't want to be your enemy, but if you force my hand...
say:1:1422695602:0.source_cn: 我不想与你们为敌，但必要如此的话……

say:0:1422696001:0.text: Looks like I missed all the excitement and only caught the final act.
say:0:1422696001:0.source_cn: 看来我错过了一场大戏，只赶上了尾声。

say:1:1422696101:1.text: The curse—it's broken. I felt the shift and dropped everything the moment I sensed it. I had to see it for myself.
say:1:1422696101:1.source_cn: 想必诅咒已经成功解除了？我在演武场里都感觉到了身上的变...

say:2:1422696102:1.text: We had it under control. You should return and tend to your duties.
say:2:1422696102:1.source_cn: 没有任何需要你赶来的地方，回去处理你的工作。

say:3:1422696103:1.text: How stern, Indris! Can't a concerned citizen pay a visit without being shooed away?
say:3:1422696103:1.source_cn: 真是冷酷无情啊，因度厄，难道你做下了如此壮举，等会儿不...

say:4:1422696104:1.text: You could also take this opportunity to introduce the breathtaking Wilder—pardon me, Scion of the Dark Forest—to the rest of us.
say:4:1422696104:1.source_cn: 还可以顺便把这位美丽的绿裔，我是说薄暮丛林的王子殿下介...

say:5:1422696105:1.text: Please don't refer to me that way...

say:6:1422696106:1.text: Hahaha, apologies, truly. You all looked so grim, I feared Thador's ghost possessed you.
say:6:1422696106:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，抱歉抱歉，因为你们一直都一副苦大仇深的样子，我...

say:7:1422696107:1.text: Thador is very much alive. He's standing right over there... His guards are still with him!
say:7:1422696107:1.source_cn: 都铎还活着呢，他就站在那边……他的卫兵还陪着他呢！

say:8:1422696108:0.text: Yes, yes. Still crying over that sapling. He didn't even act this way when my mother passed away.
say:8:1422696108:0.source_cn: 是啊，还在那对着个树苗痛哭流涕的，我母亲去世的时候他都...

say:9:1422696109:1.text: But enough of the teasing. I do have something serious to say, though you may not like it.
say:9:1422696109:1.source_cn: 不过，调侃到此为止，我也要说点你或许不爱听的，有点严肃...

say:10:1422696110:1.text: Back when you defeated my mother and left her statue in ruins, I asked you a question, Indris.
say:10:1422696110:1.source_cn: 在你刚刚击败我母亲，这里还留着她那残缺的雕像的时候，我...

say:11:1422696111:1.text: I'm going to ask it again. What kind of future do you intend to lead us toward?
say:11:1422696111:1.source_cn: 在这里，我想重复一遍。因度厄，你想为我们带来怎样的未来呢？

say:12:1422696112:1.text: You've walked the surface and visited Ivoryshade. You've endured Misarte's trials and battled Saida. These twisted histories were all uncovered...
say:12:1422696112:1.source_cn: 踏上地面，前往月影乡，甚至亲自经历了弥萨忒的考验，目睹...

say:13:1422696113:1.text: Now tell me—what do you choose?
say:13:1422696113:1.source_cn: 如今的你，会如何选择呢？

say:14:1422696114:1.text: ... I didn't get the chance to tell you about the Hypogean's deceit. How did you hear of it...?
say:14:1422696114:1.source_cn: ……我记得我还没来得及和你讲恶魔的误导之类的事吧，你到...

say:15:1422696115:1.text: And if you heard our talk just now, does that mean you arrived before we cast the spell?
say:15:1422696115:1.source_cn: 而且，你既然听到我们刚刚的对话了，所以你是从施法之前就...

choice_prompt:16:1422696115.text: And if you heard our talk just now, does that mean you arrived before we cast the spell?
choice_prompt:16:1422696115.source_cn: 而且，你既然听到我们刚刚的对话了，所以你是从施法之前就在这里了？

say:17:1422696116:1.text: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.
say:17:1422696116:1.source_cn: 我这是心系民生，别冤枉我！
say:17:1422696116:1.male: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.
say:17:1422696116:1.female: I was just concerned for the people's well-being! Such harsh accusations, Merlin.

say:18:1422696117:0.text: Forget it, I'll answer your question.
say:18:1422696117:0.source_cn: 算了，我还是回答你的问题吧。

say:20:1422696118:0.text: My decision has not changed. I believe we should return to the surface.
say:20:1422696118:0.source_cn: 经历了这些，我仍然没有改变自己的想法。我想让大家前往地表。

say:21:1422696119:1.text: Many will find joy in the sunlight with the earth beneath their feet. They'll thrive among flowers and trees, as the Wilders of Ivoryshade do.
say:21:1422696119:1.source_cn: 在这萨洛克兰，一定有很多人会喜欢阳光和大地，也会有很多...

say:22:1422696120:1.text: Like Feli... who barely saw the sun before it was ripped away from him.

say:23:1422696121:1.text: But I understand the meaning behind your question now, Ravion.
say:23:1422696121:1.source_cn: 但，我也同样清楚了，你当年那个问题的潜台词，沙利叶。

say:24:1422696122:1.text: Some will find the surface too bright, too loud, too restless.
say:24:1422696122:1.source_cn: 肯定会有人觉得地表太明亮，太吵闹，没法好好休息。

say:25:1422696123:1.text: The waters may be pure, cold, and gentle—but to some, they'll feel strange.
say:25:1422696123:1.source_cn: 水很清澈，又很冰凉柔软，但肯定也有人讨厌这种单薄透明的感受。

say:26:1422696124:1.text: Some may even resist the instinctual love for greenery, a trait from our Wilder ancestry.
say:26:1422696124:1.source_cn: 或许还会有人会抗拒对于植物的本能喜爱——这种从血脉洋溢...

say:27:1422696125:1.text: And of course... many will remain drawn to the sweet illusions of the Divine Dew.
say:27:1422696125:1.source_cn: 而且，肯定会有更多人，会继续沉迷于灵露带来的，温暖而甜...

say:28:1422696126:1.text: That, too, is part of the work that lies ahead.
say:28:1422696126:1.source_cn: ……那就是我们仍然需要处理的工作了。

say:29:1422696127:0.text: But everything else, I believe, should be a choice given to everyone.
say:29:1422696127:0.source_cn: 但，除此之外的一切，我想，都应该是给予所有人的选择。

say:31:1422696128:0.text: Ah, so let the dreamers chase the sky, and the deep-hearted sink back into their roots?
say:31:1422696128:0.source_cn: 想去地表去地表，想回地底回地底，无论在哪都有一席之地吗？

say:32:1422696129:1.text: I dare say that's the kind of answer even I could raise a toast to.

say:33:1422696130:1.text: The Lucent Tree of the Dark Forest belongs to our distant past.
say:33:1422696130:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林的流荧树，是我们遥远的过去。

say:34:1422696131:1.text: This sapling before us, it's our beginning.
say:34:1422696131:1.source_cn: 而眼前的这棵树苗，是我们全新的开始。

say:35:1422696132:1.text: ... And it's also the Essail's homeland, the place we'll inevitably look back on when we set off.
say:35:1422696132:1.source_cn: ……也是我们启程时会不禁回顾的，属于我们艾塞勒自己的—...

say:36:1422696133:1.source_cn: 就从现在开始，养育它吧。

narration:1:1422696201:0.text: As night begins to fall, you all arrive at the Lunaris Altar to attend the secret meeting...
narration:1:1422696201:0.source_cn: 黄昏时刻，你们抵达了银月祭庭，准备参与秘密集会……

say:0:1422696301:0.text: The Deer Spirit is... moving toward the Ivory Tree?
say:0:1422696301:0.source_cn: 鹿灵前进的方向……是皎月树？

say:1:1422696602:0.text: I... I have to see it for myself...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1422624002:.text: The dragon is all your fault!

say:4:1422625001:0.text: Everyone, please be quiet. We'll take questions one by one. Let's start with you. You had a question.
say:4:1422625001:0.source_cn: 诸位，诸位，安静！请依次发言，对，从你开始，有什么问题吗？

say:5:1422625002:0.text: You said something about Captain Indris letting the dragon escape.
say:5:1422625002:0.source_cn: 我刚刚听到你质疑因度厄放走了龙？

say:6:1422625003:0.text: I-I... That's not what I meant! I just don't know what I'm supposed to do now.
say:6:1422625003:0.source_cn: 我、我没有……我只是，呃，不知道该干什么了！

say:7:1422625004:0.text: It's all his fault! If he hadn't caused this mess, I'd be working my hardest trying to get into the city!
say:7:1422625004:0.source_cn: 都怪这家伙！如果不是他搞出那么多乱七八糟的事，我还有个...

say:8:1422625005:0.text: Now that I want to go to the surface, he's here to stop me! What does he want me to do? Die here or something?!
say:8:1422625005:0.source_cn: 现在，想去地表上这家伙又不让……在这里怕不是在等死……

say:10:1422625006:0.text: Yes! And he let the dragon fly away! Doesn't that mean we won't have any Divine Dew left?
say:10:1422625006:0.source_cn: 是啊，龙飞走了。那、那岂不是很快就没有恩典灵露了。

say:11:1422625007:0.text: Without the dew, won't all of us be afflicted with corruption? We can't live without it!
say:11:1422625007:0.source_cn: 没有了恩典灵露的我们，不就孽……我们不能没有恩典灵露！

say:12:1422625008:0.text: And you, did you want to say something?
say:12:1422625008:0.source_cn: 那么这位前贵族大人，您也有话要说？

say:14:1422625009:0.text: All I know is that the situation is dire! Corruption is everywhere... more than ever before!
say:14:1422625009:0.source_cn: 我，我只知道现在这样不行！到处都是孽化，到处都……比、...

say:15:1422625010:1.text: Well, the Divine Dew is still being distributed, and order is still being maintained. I also have not received any definite reports of increasing corruption.
say:15:1422625010:1.source_cn: 现在灵露还在发放，基本秩序仍在维持。关于孽化增多的说法...

say:16:1422625011:1.text: No, listen to me, Imperator Ravion!
say:16:1422625011:1.source_cn: 不不，不是这么回事，沙利叶大人！

say:17:1422625012:1.text: Many souls have succumbed to the corruption, and it takes hold faster with each passing hour!
say:17:1422625012:1.source_cn: 周围孽化的人绝对多了，而且速度也更快了！

say:18:1422625013:1.text: The only difference between now and before is the rationing of the Divine Dew. Could the dew be the source of the corruption?
say:18:1422625013:1.source_cn: 现在跟之前唯一的区别是灵露配给制，该、该不会灵露才是孽...

say:20:1422625014:0.text: What? Then I'll throw it away! I won't drink anymore! I don't want to stay here! Let me go to the surface!
say:20:1422625014:0.source_cn: 那、那我不喝了，我要扔了它！放、放我们去地面！

say:21:1422625015:0.text: Everyone calm down. Keep your Divine Dew or the situation will get worse.
say:21:1422625015:0.source_cn: 冷静！都冷静下来！先把灵露收好，丢弃它只会让情况更糟。

say:22:1422625016:0.text: I share your concerns, truly... but in these trying times, we must stand together and not let suspicion divide us.
say:22:1422625016:0.source_cn: 听着，我理解大家的恐惧，但这种时刻更需要团结而非互相猜疑。

say:23:1422625017:0.text: The dragon's departure was inevitable, yet we need not despair. The Divine Dew shall sustain us for some time still.
say:23:1422625017:0.source_cn: 龙的离开已成定局，但灵露的储备足够支撑一段时间——

say:24:1422625018:0.text: Our reserves will sustain us through the time required for us to lift the curse.
say:24:1422625018:0.source_cn: 支撑到我们找到解除一族诅咒的办法。

say:25:1422625019:0.text: The reports of increased corruption shall be investigated without delay. I'm dispatching my most trusted inquisitors as we speak. But you must all stand firm. Unchecked hysteria will undo us faster than any plague.
say:25:1422625019:0.source_cn: 至于孽化者增多的事情，我会立即派人调查核实。保持镇定，...

say:26:1422625020:0.text: Now, please return to your duties and respective posts. I give you my word that a definitive response shall follow without delay.
say:26:1422625020:0.source_cn: 现在，请大家回到各自的岗位上，继续维持正常生活。我保证...

narration:28:140130112:0.text: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.
narration:28:140130112:0.source_cn: 广场上，艾塞勒们正对因度厄宣泄着不满，因度厄难以招架。...
narration:28:140130112:0.male: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.
narration:28:140130112:0.female: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.

say:4:1422644001:1.text: Though the curse has been lifted, he remains barred from stepping onto the Spirit Mound...
say:4:1422644001:1.source_cn: 已经解除了诅咒，却仍然不被允许踏足圣丘。

say:5:1422644002:1.text: The guardians of Ivoryshade, the Mysalind, and even the messenger butterflies are blocking his path.
say:5:1422644002:1.source_cn: 守护月影乡的迈萨林德和弥萨忒的使者蝴蝶都在无声地阻拦着。

say:6:1422644003:1.text: So, even now, we who were cast out are still turned away by Misarte...
say:6:1422644003:1.source_cn: 所以，被驱逐的我们，仍然被弥萨忒所厌弃吗？

say:7:1422644004:1.text: All signs point to a deeper cause for this resistance. We must uncover it before we can proceed.
say:7:1422644004:1.source_cn: 根据我们已知的信息来推断，这种抗拒必然有更深层的原因。...

say:8:1422644005:1.text: In this matter, we must entrust the task to those whom the Deer Spirit favors more.
say:8:1422644005:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就得让更受鹿灵眷顾的人去寻求答案了。

say:9:1422644006:1.text: Bryon, seek out Eironn and have him return.
say:9:1422644006:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，设法叫埃隆回来吧。

say:10:1422644007:1.text: Eironn has been journeying of late, and his whereabouts are uncertain. I shall have Elona seek him out and deliver your summons.
say:10:1422644007:1.source_cn: 埃隆最近在外游历，位置难以确定。我会让艾洛娜去寻找，同...

narration:12:1422644008:0.text: You all watch as Bryon casts Elona into the sky and flies away. All that remains is to wait.
narration:12:1422644008:0.source_cn: 布莱恩在你们的注视下放飞了艾洛娜，接下来就是等待了……

say:13:1422644009:1.text: Very well. As we await Eironn's return, guide our guests through these lands. Let Indris, above all, walk the soil where his ancestors once roamed.
say:13:1422644009:1.source_cn: 很好。在等待他归来的时间里，就请你带着我们的客人四处走...

say:14:1422644010:1.text: Understood, Master Arden. I shall do my utmost to guide them well.
say:14:1422644010:1.source_cn: 我明白了，雅顿老师。我会尽我所能为诸位提供向导。

say:15:1422644011:1.text: Thank you, Master Bryon. I'm also eager to learn how this place differs from Sal'thorin.
say:15:1422644011:1.source_cn: 感谢你，布莱恩先生。我也……很好奇，这里和萨洛克兰的区别。

choice_prompt:16:1422644011.text: Thank you, Master Bryon. I'm also eager to learn how this place differs from Sal'thorin.
choice_prompt:16:1422644011.source_cn: 感谢你，布莱恩先生。我也……很好奇，这里和萨洛克兰的区别。

say:19:1422644012:1.text: Great! Now we can all play together!
say:19:1422644012:1.source_cn: 好诶！因度厄，主人、我和漫漫也可以带你一起玩。
say:19:1422644012:1.male: Great! Now we can all play together!
say:19:1422644012:1.female: Great! Now we can all play together!

say:20:1422644013:1.text: Stupid Chippy, stop thinking about playing all the time. Indris, there's no need to worry about Sal'thorin. Ravion is there managing the city.
say:20:1422644013:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，只想着玩。因度厄，别太担心萨洛克兰。沙利叶在...

say:21:1422644014:1.text: You're right. My thanks to you all. This chance to set foot in our ancestral homeland holds great meaning for me.
say:21:1422644014:1.source_cn: 你说得对，有劳各位。能有机会踏足曾经的家园……这对我来...

narration:23:140130204:0.text: Arden tries to lead you toward Spirit Mound, but the blue butterflies appear again, blocking Indris' path.
narration:23:140130204:0.source_cn: 雅顿尝试带领你们前往圣丘，但蓝色闪蝶再次出现，拦住了因...
narration:23:140130204:0.male: Arden tries to lead you toward Spirit Mound, but the blue butterflies appear again, blocking Indris' path.
narration:23:140130204:0.female: Arden tries to lead you toward Spirit Mound, but the blue butterflies appear again, blocking Indris' path.

say:4:1422656001:1.text: Everyone, Elona just sent word that Eironn has arrived.
say:4:1422656001:1.source_cn: 诸位，艾洛娜刚刚传信，埃隆已经抵达了。他已经先行前往了...

say:5:1422656002:1.text: Wow, that was quick! Master Arden only sent the letter not long ago, and now he's already back.
say:5:1422656002:1.source_cn: 好、好快啊？！从雅顿贤者发出信到他回来，这才过了多久？

say:6:1422656003:1.text: His destination may not have been far. Come, everyone. Let us go and meet him without delay.
say:6:1422656003:1.source_cn: 他游历之处或许不是很远。诸位，事不宜迟，我们过去与他会合吧。

say:7:1422656004:1.text: Now that Eironn is communing with the Deer Spirit, there is hope that the mystery hindering you shall be resolved.
say:7:1422656004:1.source_cn: 有埃隆与鹿灵沟通，或许能解决你被阻拦的谜团。

narration:10:140130208:0.text: As Indris gazes at the Ivory Tree, lost in thought, Elona returns with news: Eironn is back.
narration:10:140130208:0.source_cn: 因度厄望着皎月树思绪万千之际，艾洛娜返回，带来了埃隆回...

say:1:1422691201:1.text: This presence... it reeks of a Hypogean!

choice_prompt:2:1422691201.text: This presence... it reeks of a Hypogean!

say:3:1422691202:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?
say:3:1422691202:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?
say:3:1422691202:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... you mean this Hypogean is the same one that infested Eclipsion?

say:4:1422691203:1.text: That would explain it. A hidden space under the Ivory Tree, a Hypogean aura matching Sal'thorin's corruption...
say:4:1422691203:1.source_cn: 一切都解释得通了。被封印在皎月树下的秘密空间，又与萨洛...

say:5:1422691204:1.text: This Hypogean must be the very same one that once tainted the Sylvan Egg... or rather, a part of it.
say:5:1422691204:1.source_cn: 这恶魔应该也是当年污染了翡绿之卵的恶魔，或者说，是它的...

say:6:1422691205:1.text: Master, are you saying this is the corruption Misarte purged from the Sylvan Egg all those years ago?
say:6:1422691205:1.source_cn: 老师，你是说这个恶魔就是当年被弥萨忒剥离出翡绿之卵的那...

say:8:1422691206:1.text: Exactly. Two thousand years ago, a Hypogean clung to the Sylvan Egg. Misarte tore away the corrupted part, but she didn't completely destroy it.
say:8:1422691206:1.source_cn: 正是如此。两千年前，恶魔寄生于翡绿之卵，弥萨忒将污染部...

say:9:1422691207:1.text: A part of it split off and manifested as a Hypofiend. It followed the Sylvan Tendril to Sal'thorin and eventually rooted itself atop Eclipsion. There, it was contained by Helthor's power.
say:9:1422691207:1.source_cn: 而它的另一部分，跟随织叶到达了萨洛克兰，最终附着在杜恩...

say:10:1422691208:1.text: But weren't all Hypogeans sealed away by Dura? How can it still—
say:10:1422691208:1.source_cn: 当年的恶魔不是都被艾雅封印了吗？怎么会——

say:11:1422691209:1.text: Perhaps it was cleverer than we thought. Hiding within the Sylvan Egg itself... it may have slipped through Dura's grasp.
say:11:1422691209:1.source_cn: 或许，它比想象中棘手。比如凭借寄生在翡绿之卵上的优势，...

say:12:1422691210:1.text: That would mean it still holds the power to provoke Misarte's wrath... and shake the foundations of the Vaduso Mountains themselves. I have to—
say:12:1422691210:1.source_cn: 看来，它有着能让弥萨忒降下惩戒，动摇瓦度索的力量。我得——

narration:18:140130411:0.text: A Hypogean hatches from the egg.
narration:18:140130411:0.source_cn: 恶魔从卵中孕育了出来。

choice:2:0:1.text: The same aura I sensed on the bow.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 跟我在杜恩加尔上感受的一致
choice:2:0:1.male: The same aura I sensed on the bow.
choice:2:0:1.female: The same aura I sensed on the bow.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1422637001:.text: The butterflies are blocking our path!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1422637001:.male: The butterflies are blocking our path!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1422637001:.female: The butterflies are blocking our path!

subtitle:1:1411096001:.text: Rebirth... once again, I seek to rise anew.

subtitle:1:1411096002:.text: She is about to be reborn.

subtitle:1:1411096003:.text: No, she'll never be killed this way.
subtitle:1:1411096003:.source_cn: 不行，这样永远杀不死她

subtitle:1:1411096008:.text: She's weak! Let's put an end to this!
subtitle:1:1411096008:.source_cn: 她被削弱了，做个了结吧！

subtitle:1:1411096009:.text: I... I will be reborn again...

subtitle:1:1411096011:.text: The Deer Spirit has seized her power.
subtitle:1:1411096011:.source_cn: 梅林，鹿灵压制了她的力量
subtitle:1:1411096011:.male: The Deer Spirit has seized her power.
subtitle:1:1411096011:.female: The Deer Spirit has seized her power.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1422670101:.source_cn: 是水元素！要袭击因度厄！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1422686002:.text: Let's return to the Dark Forest and hand it over.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1422686002:.source_cn: 咱们尽快返回薄暮森林，把它交给老师吧。
